5.135.s:
māṃḍavya uvāca .. ..
grahīṣyāmi suraśreṣṭhā varaṃ yuṣmatsamudravam ..
paraṃ me nirṇayaṃ caikaṃ dharmarājaḥ pracakṣatu.. . 1 ..
5.135.d:
मांडव्य उवाच .. ..
ग्रहीष्यामि सुरश्रेष्ठा वरं युष्मत्समुद्रवम् ..
परं मे निर्णयं चैकं धर्मराजः प्रचक्षतु.. . 1 ..
5.135.m: Māṇḍavya said: / 'O best of gods, I shall accept a boon arising from you. / But let Dharmarāja explain to me one decisive matter:

5.135.s:
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ loke kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ..
upatiṣṭhati nānyatra satyametatsurottamāḥ .. 2 ..
5.135.d:
सर्वेषां प्राणिनां लोके कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् ..
उपतिष्ठति नान्यत्र सत्यमेतत्सुरोत्तमाः .. 2 ..
5.135.m: For all living beings in the world, the good or bad deed done / approaches [them] and none other; this is true, O best of gods.

5.135.s:
mayāpyatra pare cāpi kiṃ kṛtaṃ pātakaṃ ca yat ..
īdṛśīṃ vedanāṃ prāpto na ca mṛtyuṃ kathacana .. 3 ..
5.135.d:
मयाप्यत्र परे चापि किं कृतं पातकं च यत् ..
ईदृशीं वेदनां प्राप्तो न च मृत्युं कथचन .. 3 ..
5.135.m: What sin was committed by me here or in another [life], / that I have suffered such pain and yet by no means met death?'

5.135.s:
.. dharmarāja uvāca .. ..
anyadehe tvayā vipra bālabhāvena vartatā ..
śūlāgreṇa sutīkṣṇena kāye viddho bakaḥ kṣitau .. 4 ..
5.135.d:
.. धर्मराज उवाच .. ..
अन्यदेहे त्वया विप्र बालभावेन वर्तता ..
शूलाग्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन काये विद्धो बकः क्षितौ .. 4 ..
5.135.m: Dharmarāja said: / 'In another body, O brahmin, while you were still a child, / a heron was pierced on the ground in its body by you with the very sharp tip of a spike.

5.135.s:
nānyatkṛtamapi svalpaṃ pātakaṃ kiṃcideva hi ..
etasmātkāraṇādeṣā vyathā saṃsevitā dvija .. 5 .. ..
5.135.d:
नान्यत्कृतमपि स्वल्पं पातकं किंचिदेव हि ..
एतस्मात्कारणादेषा व्यथा संसेविता द्विज .. 5 .. ..
5.135.m: Indeed, not even the slightest other sin was committed [by you]. / For that reason alone was this agony endured [by you], O twice-born.'

5.135.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ ..
tatastaṃ prāha māṃḍavyo dharmarājaṃ puraḥ sthitam .. 6 ..
5.135.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भृशं क्रोधसमन्वितः ..
ततस्तं प्राह मांडव्यो धर्मराजं पुरः स्थितम् .. 6 ..
5.135.m: Sūta said: / Hearing those words of his, filled with intense rage, / Māṇḍavya then addressed Dharmarāja standing before him:

5.135.s:
asya svalpāparādhasya yasmādbhūyānvinigrahaḥ ..
kṛtastvayā sudurbuddhe tasmācchāpaṃ gṛhāṇa me .. 7 ..
5.135.d:
अस्य स्वल्पापराधस्य यस्माद्भूयान्विनिग्रहः ..
कृतस्त्वया सुदुर्बुद्धे तस्माच्छापं गृहाण मे .. 7 ..
5.135.m: 'Since for this tiny fault such excessive punishment / was meted out by you, O evil-minded one, therefore receive my curse:

5.135.s:
tvaṃ prāpya mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ śūdrayonau vyavasthitaḥ ..
jātikṣayakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ prabhūtaṃ sevayiṣyasi .. 8 ..
5.135.d:
त्वं प्राप्य मानुषं देहं शूद्रयोनौ व्यवस्थितः ..
जातिक्षयकृतं दुःखं प्रभूतं सेवयिष्यसि .. 8 ..
5.135.m: Having obtained a human body and abiding in a śūdra's womb, / you shall experience immense suffering brought about by the destruction of [your] kinsmen.

5.135.s:
tathā kṛtā mayaiṣādya vyavasthā sarvadehinām ..
aṣṭamādvatsarādūrdhyaṃ karmaṇā garhitena ca ..
pragrahīṣyati vai jaṃtuḥ puruṣo yoṣideva vā .. 9 ..
5.135.d:
तथा कृता मयैषाद्य व्यवस्था सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
अष्टमाद्वत्सरादूर्ध्यं कर्मणा गर्हितेन च ..
प्रग्रहीष्यति वै जंतुः पुरुषो योषिदेव वा .. 9 ..
5.135.m: And today I have established this rule for all embodied beings: / only after the eighth year will a living creature, whether man or woman, / actually take on [guilt] through a censured deed.'

5.135.s:
evamuktvā sa māṃḍavyo dharmarājaṃ tataḥ param ..
prasthito roṣanirmukto vāṃchitāśāṃ prati dvijāḥ .. 6.136.10 ..
5.135.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स मांडव्यो धर्मराजं ततः परम् ..
प्रस्थितो रोषनिर्मुक्तो वांछिताशां प्रति द्विजाः .. 6.136.10 ..
5.135.m: Having spoken thus to Dharmarāja, that Māṇḍavya then / departed, freed from anger, towards the quarter he desired, O twice-born.

5.135.s:
atha taṃ prasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā procuḥ sarve divaukasaḥ ..
dharmarājakṛte vyagrāḥ śrutvā śāpaṃ tathāvidham .. 11 ..
5.135.d:
अथ तं प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा प्रोचुः सर्वे दिवौकसः ..
धर्मराजकृते व्यग्राः श्रुत्वा शापं तथाविधम् .. 11 ..
5.135.m: Then, seeing him depart, all the sky-dwellers spoke, / anxious on account of Dharmarāja, having heard a curse of that kind.

5.135.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavanpāpasaktasya dharmarājasya kevalam..
na tvamarhasi śāpena śūdraṃ kartuṃ kathaṃcana .. 12 ..
5.135.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
भगवन्पापसक्तस्य धर्मराजस्य केवलम्..
न त्वमर्हसि शापेन शूद्रं कर्तुं कथंचन .. 12 ..
5.135.m: The gods said: / 'O venerable one, Dharmarāja is devoted solely to righteousness; / you ought not by any means make him a śūdra through a curse.

5.135.s:
prasādaṃ kuru tasmāttvamasya dharmapaterdvija ..
asmākaṃ vacanātsadyaḥ prārthayasva tathā varam .. .. 13 ..
5.135.d:
प्रसादं कुरु तस्मात्त्वमस्य धर्मपतेर्द्विज ..
अस्माकं वचनात्सद्यः प्रार्थयस्व तथा वरम् .. .. 13 ..
5.135.m: Therefore, show grace to this lord of righteousness, O twice-born, / and at our word, immediately ask for a boon as well.'

5.135.s:
.. māṃḍavya uvāca .. ..
nānyathā jāyate vāṇī yā mayoktā surottamāḥ ..
avaśyaṃ dharmarājo'yaṃ śūdrayonau prayāsyati .. 14 ..
5.135.d:
.. मांडव्य उवाच .. ..
नान्यथा जायते वाणी या मयोक्ता सुरोत्तमाः ..
अवश्यं धर्मराजोऽयं शूद्रयोनौ प्रयास्यति .. 14 ..
5.135.m: Māṇḍavya said: / 'The word that has been spoken by me cannot turn out otherwise, O best of gods. / Dharmarāja will inevitably enter a śūdra's womb.

5.135.s:
paraṃ naivāsya saṃtānaṃ tasyāṃ yonau bhaviṣyati ..
saṃprāpsyati ca bhūyo'pi dharmarājatvamuttamam .. 15 ..
5.135.d:
परं नैवास्य संतानं तस्यां योनौ भविष्यति ..
संप्राप्स्यति च भूयोऽपि धर्मराजत्वमुत्तमम् .. 15 ..
5.135.m: However, he will have no offspring in that womb, / and he will attain the supreme state of Dharmarāja once again.

5.135.s:
ārādhayatu cāvyagraḥ kṣetre'traiva trilocanam ..
prasādāttasya devasya śīghraṃ mṛtyumavāpsyati .. 16 ..
5.135.d:
आराधयतु चाव्यग्रः क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव त्रिलोचनम् ..
प्रसादात्तस्य देवस्य शीघ्रं मृत्युमवाप्स्यति .. 16 ..
5.135.m: And let him, untroubled, worship the Three-eyed Lord right in this sacred field; / by the grace of that god, he shall swiftly meet death.

5.135.s:
tathā deyo varo mahyaṃ bhavadbhiryadi svargapāḥ ..
tadeṣā śūlikā'smākaṃ sparśādbhūyātsudharmadā .. .. 17 ..
5.135.d:
तथा देयो वरो मह्यं भवद्भिर्यदि स्वर्गपाः ..
तदेषा शूलिकाऽस्माकं स्पर्शाद्भूयात्सुधर्मदा .. .. 17 ..
5.135.m: Likewise, if a boon is to be granted to me by you, O guardians of heaven, / then let this spike, by our touch, bestow great merit.'

5.135.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
enāṃ yaḥ prātarutthāya sparśayiṣyati śūlikām ..
pātakātsa vimukto vā iha loke bhaviṣyati .. 18 ..
5.135.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
एनां यः प्रातरुत्थाय स्पर्शयिष्यति शूलिकाम् ..
पातकात्स विमुक्तो वा इह लोके भविष्यति .. 18 ..
5.135.m: The gods said: / 'Whoever rises in the morning and touches this spike / shall be freed from sin in this world.'

5.135.s:
evamuktvā muniṃ taṃ te devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ..
tatastāṃ sādaraṃ prāhuḥ saha bhartrā pativratām .. 19 ..
5.135.d:
एवमुक्त्वा मुनिं तं ते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ..
ततस्तां सादरं प्राहुः सह भर्त्रा पतिव्रताम् .. 19 ..
5.135.m: Having spoken thus to that sage, those gods headed by Śakra / then spoke respectfully to that devoted wife together with her husband:

5.135.s:
tvamapi prārthayābhīṣṭamasmatto varavarṇini ..
yatte citte sthitaṃ nityaṃ nādeyaṃ vidyate'tra naḥ .. 6.136.20 ..
5.135.d:
त्वमपि प्रार्थयाभीष्टमस्मत्तो वरवर्णिनि ..
यत्ते चित्ते स्थितं नित्यं नादेयं विद्यतेऽत्र नः .. 6.136.20 ..
5.135.m: 'You too ask of us what you desire, O lady of fair complexion, / whatever constantly resides in your mind; nothing is impossible for us to grant here.'

5.135.s:
.. pativratovāca .. ..
yeyaṃ mayākṛtā gartā sthāne'tra tridaśeśvarāḥ ..
mannāmnā khyātimāyātu dīrghiketi jagattraye .. 21 ..
5.135.d:
.. पतिव्रतोवाच .. ..
येयं मयाकृता गर्ता स्थानेऽत्र त्रिदशेश्वराः ..
मन्नाम्ना ख्यातिमायातु दीर्घिकेति जगत्त्रये .. 21 ..
5.135.m: The devoted wife said: / 'May this ditch that has been made by me in this place, O lords of the thirty [gods], / attain renown in the three worlds under my name as Dīrghikā.'

5.135.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
adyaprabhṛti loke'tra gartteyaṃ tava śobhane ..
dīrghiketi suvikhyātā bhaviṣyati jagattraye .. 22 ..
5.135.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति लोकेऽत्र गर्त्तेयं तव शोभने ..
दीर्घिकेति सुविख्याता भविष्यति जगत्त्रये .. 22 ..
5.135.m: The gods said: / 'From this day forward in this world, this ditch of yours, O fair lady, / shall be celebrated throughout the three worlds as Dīrghikā.

5.135.s:
ye'syāṃ snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti prātarutthāya mānavāḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktāste bhaviṣyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt .. 23 ..
5.135.d:
येऽस्यां स्नानं करिष्यंति प्रातरुत्थाय मानवाः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते भविष्यंति तत्क्षणात् .. 23 ..
5.135.m: Those men who take a ritual ablution in it after rising in the morning / shall immediately become freed from all sins.

5.135.s:
kanyārāśigate sūrye saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā sahitā narāḥ .. 24 ..
5.135.d:
कन्याराशिगते सूर्ये संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने ..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति श्रद्धया सहिता नराः .. 24 ..
5.135.m: When the sun enters the sign of Virgo and the fifth day has arrived, / those people who take a ritual ablution here with faith

5.135.s:
aputrāste bhaviṣyaṃti saputrā vaṃśavardhanāḥ ..
evamuktvā'tha tāṃ devā jagmuḥ svargaṃ dvijottamāḥ.. .. 25 ..
5.135.d:
अपुत्रास्ते भविष्यंति सपुत्रा वंशवर्धनाः ..
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ तां देवा जग्मुः स्वर्गं द्विजोत्तमाः.. .. 25 ..
5.135.m: shall, if childless, be blessed with sons who propagate their lineage.' / Having spoken thus to her, the gods went to heaven, O best of twice-born.

5.135.s:
pativratāpi tenaiva saha kāṃtena sundarī ..
sevayāmāsa kalyāṇī smarasaukhyamanuttamam .. 26 ..
5.135.d:
पतिव्रतापि तेनैव सह कांतेन सुन्दरी ..
सेवयामास कल्याणी स्मरसौख्यमनुत्तमम् .. 26 ..
5.135.m: The devoted wife, a lovely and auspicious lady, / enjoyed the unsurpassed bliss of love with that very beloved [of hers]

5.135.s:
parvateṣu suramyeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca ..
udyāneṣu vicitreṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca .. 27 ..
5.135.d:
पर्वतेषु सुरम्येषु नदीनां पुलिनेषु च ..
उद्यानेषु विचित्रेषु वनेषूपवनेषु च .. 27 ..
5.135.m: upon charming mountains and on river sandbanks, / in variegated gardens, and in forests and groves.

5.135.s:
tato vayasi saṃprāpte paścime kālaparyayāt .
tadevātmīyasattīrthaṃ sevayāmāsa sādaram .. 28 ..
5.135.d:
ततो वयसि संप्राप्ते पश्चिमे कालपर्ययात् .
तदेवात्मीयसत्तीर्थं सेवयामास सादरम् .. 28 ..
5.135.m: Then, when old age arrived through the lapse of time, / she devotedly resorted to that very true sacred ford of her own.

5.135.s:
tato dehaṃ parityaktvā svakāṃtaṃ vīkṣya taṃ mṛtam ..
tatra toye jagāmātha brahmalokaṃ pativratā . 29 ..
5.135.d:
ततो देहं परित्यक्त्वा स्वकांतं वीक्ष्य तं मृतम् ..
तत्र तोये जगामाथ ब्रह्मलोकं पतिव्रता . 29 ..
5.135.m: Then, having cast off her body upon seeing her beloved dead, / the devoted wife went to the world of Brahmā in that water.

5.135.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ dīrghikākhyānamuttamam ..
yasya saṃśravaṇādeva naraḥ pāpātpramucyate .. 6.136.30 ..
5.135.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं दीर्घिकाख्यानमुत्तमम् ..
यस्य संश्रवणादेव नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते .. 6.136.30 ..
5.135.m: All this, the supreme narrative of Dīrghikā, has been related to you, / simply by hearing which a person is liberated from sin.

5.135.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe hāṭakeśvara kṣetramāhātmye dīrghikotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 136
5.135.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे हाटकेश्वर क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दीर्घिकोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 136
5.135.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-sixth chapter, named 'The Description of the Origin and Greatness of Dīrghikā,' in the māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.136.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kenāsau muniśārdūlo māṃḍavyaḥ sumahātapāḥ ..
śūlāyāṃ sthāpitaḥ kena kāraṇena ca no vada .. 1 ..
5.136.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
केनासौ मुनिशार्दूलो मांडव्यः सुमहातपाः ..
शूलायां स्थापितः केन कारणेन च नो वद .. 1 ..
5.136.m: The seers said: / 'By whom was this tiger among sages, Māṇḍavya, of great austerity, / placed upon the spike, and for what reason? Tell us.'

5.136.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa māṃḍavyo muniḥ pūrvaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ samācaran ..
asminkṣetre samāyātaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 2 ..
5.136.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स मांडव्यो मुनिः पूर्वं तीर्थयात्रां समाचरन् ..
अस्मिन्क्षेत्रे समायातः श्रद्धया परया युतः .. 2 ..
5.136.m: Sūta said: / 'Formerly, that sage Māṇḍavya, undertaking a pilgrimage to sacred fords, / arrived in this sacred field endowed with the highest faith.

5.136.s:
viśvāmitrīyamāsādya sattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ..
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cakre bhāskaraṃ prati sa vratī .. 3 ..
5.136.d:
विश्वामित्रीयमासाद्य सत्तीर्थं पावनं महत् ..
पितॄणां तर्पणं चक्रे भास्करं प्रति स व्रती .. 3 ..
5.136.m: Having reached the great and purifying true sacred ford of Viśvāmitra, / that observer of vows performed the libation to the ancestors facing the Sun,

5.136.s:
japanvibhrāḍiti śreṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ bhāskaravallabham ..
etasminnaṃtare cauro loptramādāya kasyacit .. 4 ..
5.136.d:
जपन्विभ्राडिति श्रेष्ठं सूक्तं भास्करवल्लभम् ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे चौरो लोप्त्रमादाय कस्यचित् .. 4 ..
5.136.m: reciting the excellent hymn beginning with "vibhrāṭ", dear to the Sun. / Meanwhile, a certain thief carrying stolen goods

5.136.s:
kopi tatra samāyātaḥ pṛṣṭhe lagnairjanairdvijāḥ ..
tataścauro'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā maunasthaṃ munisattamam .. 5 ..
5.136.d:
कोपि तत्र समायातः पृष्ठे लग्नैर्जनैर्द्विजाः ..
ततश्चौरोऽपि तं दृष्ट्वा मौनस्थं मुनिसत्तमम् .. 5 ..
5.136.m: came there, pursued closely from behind by people, O twice-born. / Then the thief too, seeing that best of sages observing silence,

5.136.s:
loptraṃ muktvā tadagre'tha praviveśa guhāṃtare ..
etasminnaṃtare prāptāste janā loptrahetave .. 6 ..
5.136.d:
लोप्त्रं मुक्त्वा तदग्रेऽथ प्रविवेश गुहांतरे ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तास्ते जना लोप्त्रहेतवे .. 6 ..
5.136.m: dropped the stolen goods in front of him and entered inside a cave. / Meanwhile, those people arrived in pursuit of the stolen goods.

5.136.s:
dṛṣṭvā loptraṃ tadagrasthaṃ tamūcurmunipuṃgavam ..
mārgeṇānena cāyāto loptrahasto malimlucaḥ ..
brūhi śīghraṃ mahābhāga kena mārgeṇa nirgataḥ .. 7 ..
5.136.d:
दृष्ट्वा लोप्त्रं तदग्रस्थं तमूचुर्मुनिपुंगवम् ..
मार्गेणानेन चायातो लोप्त्रहस्तो मलिम्लुचः ..
ब्रूहि शीघ्रं महाभाग केन मार्गेण निर्गतः .. 7 ..
5.136.m: Seeing the stolen goods lying in front of him, they said to that eminent sage: / "A thief with stolen goods in hand came by this path. / Tell us quickly, O fortunate one, by which path did he escape?"'

5.136.s:
sa ca jānannapi prājño guhāsaṃsthaṃ malimlucam ..
na kiṃcidapi covāca maunavrata parāyaṇaḥ .. 8 ..
5.136.d:
स च जानन्नपि प्राज्ञो गुहासंस्थं मलिम्लुचम् ..
न किंचिदपि चोवाच मौनव्रत परायणः .. 8 ..
5.136.m: And although the wise [sage] knew that the thief was inside the cave, / committed to his vow of silence, he said nothing at all.

5.136.s:
asakṛtprocyamāno'pi paraciṃtāsamanvitaḥ ..
yadā provāca no kiṃcitsa rakṣaṃścaurajīvitam .. 9 ..
5.136.d:
असकृत्प्रोच्यमानोऽपि परचिंतासमन्वितः ..
यदा प्रोवाच नो किंचित्स रक्षंश्चौरजीवितम् .. 9 ..
5.136.m: Though questioned repeatedly, engaged in supreme contemplation, / he said nothing, thereby protecting the thief's life.

5.136.s:
tatastairmaṃtritaṃ sarvaireṣa nūnaṃ malimlucaḥ ..
saṃprāptaḥ pṛṣṭhato'smābhirmunirūpo babhūva ha .. 6.137.10 ..
5.136.d:
ततस्तैर्मंत्रितं सर्वैरेष नूनं मलिम्लुचः ..
संप्राप्तः पृष्ठतोऽस्माभिर्मुनिरूपो बभूव ह .. 6.137.10 ..
5.136.m: Then they all conferred among themselves: “This is surely the thief! / Followed by us, he has assumed the form of a sage.”

5.136.s:
avicārya tataḥ sarvairābhīraistairdurātmabhiḥ..
śūlīmāropitaḥ sadyo nītvā kiṃcidvanāṃtaram .. 11 ..
5.136.d:
अविचार्य ततः सर्वैराभीरैस्तैर्दुरात्मभिः..
शूलीमारोपितः सद्यो नीत्वा किंचिद्वनांतरम् .. 11 ..
5.136.m: Then, without deliberating, all those wicked cowherds / took him a short distance into another part of the forest and immediately impaled him upon a stake.

5.136.s:
evaṃ prāptā tadā śūlī muninā tena dāruṇā ..
pūrvakarmavipākena doṣahīnena dhīmatā ..12..
5.136.d:
एवं प्राप्ता तदा शूली मुनिना तेन दारुणा ..
पूर्वकर्मविपाकेन दोषहीनेन धीमता ..12..
5.136.m: Thus the dreadful stake was received then by that wise sage, / free from fault, through the ripening of past deeds.

5.136.s: itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye māṃḍavyaśūlīprāptivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaraśatatamokyayāyaḥ .. 137 .. .. dha ..
5.136.d: इतिश्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मांडव्यशूलीप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोक्ययायः .. 137 .. .. ध ..
5.136.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Event of Māṇḍavya’s Impalement,” in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Purāṇa.

5.137.s:
.. .. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kiṃ kṛtaṃ dharmarājena tapodhyānādikaṃ ca yat..
māṃḍavyaśāpanāśāya tadasmākaṃ prakīrtaya .. 1 ..
5.137.d:
.. .. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
किं कृतं धर्मराजेन तपोध्यानादिकं च यत्..
मांडव्यशापनाशाय तदस्माकं प्रकीर्तय .. 1 ..
5.137.m: The seers said: / What austerity, meditation, and the like was performed by Dharmarāja / for the destruction of Māṇḍavya's curse? Proclaim that to us!

5.137.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
māṃḍavya śāpamāsādya dharmarājaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ..
tapastepe dvijaśreṣṭhāstasminkṣetre vyavasthitaḥ .. 2 ..
5.137.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
मांडव्य शापमासाद्य धर्मराजः सुदुःखितः ..
तपस्तेपे द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थितः .. 2 ..
5.137.m: Sūta said: / Having incurred the curse of Māṇḍavya, Dharmarāja was deeply afflicted with sorrow; / residing in that sacred field, O best of the twice-born, he performed austerity.

5.137.s:
prāsādaṃ devadevasya saṃvidhāya kapardinaḥ ..
avyagraṃ pūjayāmāsa puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.137.d:
प्रासादं देवदेवस्य संविधाय कपर्दिनः ..
अव्यग्रं पूजयामास पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः .. 3 ..
5.137.m: Having constructed a temple for the God of gods, the matted-haired Śiva, / he worshipped him without distraction with flowers, incenses, and ointments.

5.137.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ ..
provāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yadīpsitam .. 4 ..
5.137.d:
ततः कालेन महता तुष्टस्तस्य महेश्वरः ..
प्रोवाच वरदोऽस्मीति प्रार्थयस्व यदीप्सितम् .. 4 ..
5.137.m: Then, after a long time, Maheśvara was pleased with him / and said: “I am the giver of boons; ask for whatever is desired.”

5.137.s:
.. dharmarāja uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ deva purā śapto māṃḍavyena mahātmanā ..
svadharme vartamāno'pi sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ .. 5 ..
5.137.d:
.. धर्मराज उवाच .. ..
अहं देव पुरा शप्तो मांडव्येन महात्मना ..
स्वधर्मे वर्तमानोऽपि सर्वदोषविवर्जितः .. 5 ..
5.137.m: Dharmarāja said: / O God, previously I was cursed by the high-souled Māṇḍavya, / even while abiding by my own duty and being completely free of fault.
And by him, being enraged, it was said: “You will be born in the womb of a Śūdra!”

5.137.s:
tatrāpi ca mahadduḥkhaṃ jñātināśasamudravam ..
macchāpajanitaṃ sadyo jātijaṃ samavāpsyasi .. 7 ..
5.137.d:
तत्रापि च महद्दुःखं ज्ञातिनाशसमुद्रवम् ..
मच्छापजनितं सद्यो जातिजं समवाप्स्यसि .. 7 ..
5.137.m: “And even there, born of my curse, you will directly obtain great suffering / arising from the destruction of your kin, suffering caused by that birth.”

5.137.s:
tasmāttrāhi suraśreṣṭha tasyā yoneḥ sakāśataḥ ..
kathaṃ caitadvidho bhūtvā tasyāṃ janma karomyaham ..8..
5.137.d:
तस्मात्त्राहि सुरश्रेष्ठ तस्या योनेः सकाशतः ..
कथं चैतद्विधो भूत्वा तस्यां जन्म करोम्यहम् ..8..
5.137.m: Therefore, save me, O best of gods, from that womb! / And being such as I am, how can I take birth in it?

5.137.s:
tatrāpi ca mahaduḥkhaṃ jñātināśasamudbhavam ..
etadarthe suraśreṣṭha mayā cārādhito bhavān ..9.. ..
5.137.d:
तत्रापि च महदुःखं ज्ञातिनाशसमुद्भवम् ..
एतदर्थे सुरश्रेष्ठ मया चाराधितो भवान् ..9.. ..
5.137.m: And even there, great suffering arises from the destruction of kin. / For this sake, O best of gods, you have been worshipped by me.

5.137.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
na tasya sanmunervākyaṃ śakyate kartumanyathā ..
tasmācchūdro'pi bhūtvā tvaṃ na saṃtānamavāpsyasi .. 6.138.10 ..
5.137.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
न तस्य सन्मुनेर्वाक्यं शक्यते कर्तुमन्यथा ..
तस्माच्छूद्रोऽपि भूत्वा त्वं न संतानमवाप्स्यसि .. 6.138.10 ..
5.137.m: The Holy One said: / The word of that true sage cannot be made otherwise; / therefore, though having become a Śūdra, you shall not incur suffering.

5.137.s:
jñātikṣayaṃ pradṛṣṭvāpi naiva duḥkhamavāpsyasi ..
yato niṣidhyamānāpi na kariṣyaṃti te vacaḥ .. 11 ..
5.137.d:
ज्ञातिक्षयं प्रदृष्ट्वापि नैव दुःखमवाप्स्यसि ..
यतो निषिध्यमानापि न करिष्यंति ते वचः .. 11 ..
5.137.m: Even upon witnessing the destruction of your kin, you will not experience grief at all, / because even when restrained, they will not heed your word.

5.137.s:
etasmātkāraṇāccitte na te duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
jñātijaṃ dharmarājaitatsatyameva mayoditam .. 12 ..
5.137.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाच्चित्ते न ते दुःखं भविष्यति ..
ज्ञातिजं धर्मराजैतत्सत्यमेव मयोदितम् .. 12 ..
5.137.m: For this reason, there will be no grief in your mind / arising from kin, O Dharmarāja; this is the absolute truth spoken by me.

5.137.s:
sthitvā varṣaśataṃ prājña tvaṃ śūdro dharmavatsalaḥ ..
upadeśānbahūndattvā jñātibhyo hitakāmyayā ..
api śraddhā vihīneṣu pāpātmasu sadaiva hi .. 13 ..
5.137.d:
स्थित्वा वर्षशतं प्राज्ञ त्वं शूद्रो धर्मवत्सलः ..
उपदेशान्बहून्दत्त्वा ज्ञातिभ्यो हितकाम्यया ..
अपि श्रद्धा विहीनेषु पापात्मसु सदैव हि .. 13 ..
5.137.m: Having lived for a hundred years, O wise one, as a Śūdra devoted to righteousness, / having given many teachings to your kin out of a desire for their welfare, / even though they are ever devoid of faith and sinful in nature,

5.137.s:
tato varṣaśate pūrṇe brahmadvāreṇa kevalam ..
ātmānaṃ samyagutsṛjya mokṣameva prayāsyasi .. 14 ..
5.137.d:
ततो वर्षशते पूर्णे ब्रह्मद्वारेण केवलम् ..
आत्मानं सम्यगुत्सृज्य मोक्षमेव प्रयास्यसि .. 14 ..
5.137.m: then, when the hundred years are complete, solely through the gateway of Brahman, / thoroughly releasing yourself, you will attain liberation alone.

5.137.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāngataścādarśanaṃ tataḥ ..
dharmarājo'pi taṃ śāpaṃ bheje māṃḍavyasaṃbhavam .. 15 ..
5.137.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्गतश्चादर्शनं ततः ..
धर्मराजोऽपि तं शापं भेजे मांडव्यसंभवम् .. 15 ..
5.137.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord then vanished from sight; / and Dharmarāja accepted that curse born of Māṇḍavya.

5.137.s:
tadā vidurarūpeṇa hyavatīrya dharātale ..
māṃḍavyasya vacaḥ satyaṃ sa cakāra mahāmatiḥ .. 16 ..
5.137.d:
तदा विदुररूपेण ह्यवतीर्य धरातले ..
मांडव्यस्य वचः सत्यं स चकार महामतिः .. 16 ..
5.137.m: Then, having descended to the surface of the earth in the form of Vidura, / that highly intelligent one made the word of Māṇḍavya come true.

5.137.s:
jāto bhagavatā sākṣādvyāsenāmitatejasā ..
pārāśaryeṇa vipreṇa dāsīgarbhasamudbhavaḥ .. 17 ..
5.137.d:
जातो भगवता साक्षाद्व्यासेनामिततेजसा ..
पाराशर्येण विप्रेण दासीगर्भसमुद्भवः .. 17 ..
5.137.m: Born directly from the Lord Vyāsa of immeasurable splendour, / the son of Parāśara, a brahmin, he was born from the womb of a maidservant.

5.137.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ dharmarājasamudbhavam ..
ākhyānaṃ yadahaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 18 ..
5.137.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं धर्मराजसमुद्भवम् ..
आख्यानं यदहं पृष्टः सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 18 ..
5.137.m: This entire narrative concerning Dharmarāja, which destroys all sins, / about which I was asked, has been related to you.

5.137.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dharmarājeśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaraśatatamoadhyāyaḥ .. 138..
5.137.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहरस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धर्मराजेश्वरोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनामाष्टात्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोअध्यायः .. 138..
5.137.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-eighth chapter, entitled “Description of the Origin of Dharmarājeśvara,” in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Purāṇa.

5.138.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dharmarājeśvarotthaṃ ca māhātmyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
yanmayā praśrutaṃ puṇyaṃ sakāśātsvapituḥ purā .. 1 ..
5.138.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
धर्मराजेश्वरोत्थं च माहात्म्यं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
यन्मया प्रश्रुतं पुण्यं सकाशात्स्वपितुः पुरा .. 1 ..
5.138.m: Sūta said: / O best of the twice-born, the sacred māhātmya arising from Dharmarājeśvara, / which was formerly heard by me from my father,

5.138.s:
tadahaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ ..
trailokye'pi suvikhyātaṃ sarva pātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
5.138.d:
तदहं कीर्तयिष्यामि शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः ..
त्रैलोक्येऽपि सुविख्यातं सर्व पातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
5.138.m: that I will proclaim; listen with focused minds! / It is renowned throughout the three worlds and destroys all sins.

5.138.s:
tatra kṣetre purā vipraḥ kaśyapānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ..
upādhyāya iti khyāto vedavidyāparāyaṇaḥ .. 3 ..
5.138.d:
तत्र क्षेत्रे पुरा विप्रः कश्यपान्वयसंभवः ..
उपाध्याय इति ख्यातो वेदविद्यापरायणः .. 3 ..
5.138.m: In that sacred field, in ancient times, there was a brahmin born of the lineage of Kaśyapa, / renowned as Upādhyāya, dedicated to the study of the Vedas.

5.138.s:
paścime vayasi prāpte tasya putro babhūva ha ..
svādhyāyaniyamasthasya prabhūtavibhavasya ca ..4..
5.138.d:
पश्चिमे वयसि प्राप्ते तस्य पुत्रो बभूव ह ..
स्वाध्यायनियमस्थस्य प्रभूतविभवस्य च ..4..
5.138.m: When he had reached his later age, a son was born to him / who remained steadfast in the rules of Vedic study and possessed great wealth.

5.138.s:
pañcavarṣakamātrastu yadā jajñe ca tatsutaḥ ..
tadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ prāptaḥ pitṛmātṛsuduḥkhakṛt ..5..
5.138.d:
पञ्चवर्षकमात्रस्तु यदा जज्ञे च तत्सुतः ..
तदा मृत्युवशं प्राप्तः पितृमातृसुदुःखकृत् ..5..
5.138.m: When his son was only five years old, / he fell under the sway of death, causing immense grief to his mother and father.

5.138.s:
tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ kopaṃ cakre vaivasvatopari ..
dharmarājagṛhaṃ prāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā nijakumārakam .. 6 ..
5.138.d:
ततः स ब्राह्मणः कोपं चक्रे वैवस्वतोपरि ..
धर्मराजगृहं प्राप्तं दृष्ट्वा निजकुमारकम् .. 6 ..
5.138.m: Then that brahmin became enraged at the son of Vivasvat, / seeing his own young boy arrived at the abode of Dharmarāja.

5.138.s:
ādāya salilaṃ haste śucirbhūtvāsamāhitaḥ ..
pradadau dāruṇaṃ śāpaṃ dharmarājāya duḥkhitaḥ .. 7 ..
5.138.d:
आदाय सलिलं हस्ते शुचिर्भूत्वासमाहितः ..
प्रददौ दारुणं शापं धर्मराजाय दुःखितः .. 7 ..
5.138.m: Taking water in his hand, having purified himself, agitated in mind, / the sorrowful one pronounced a terrible curse upon Dharmarāja:

5.138.s:
aputro'dya kṛto yasmādahaṃ tena durātmanā ..
ataḥ so'pi ca duṣṭātmā yamo'putro bhaviṣyati .. 8 ..
5.138.d:
अपुत्रोऽद्य कृतो यस्मादहं तेन दुरात्मना ..
अतः सोऽपि च दुष्टात्मा यमोऽपुत्रो भविष्यति .. 8 ..
5.138.m: “Since I have been made sonless today by that evil-minded one, / therefore that wicked-souled Yama too shall be childless!”

5.138.s:
tathāsya bhūtale loko naiva pūjāṃ vidhāsyati ..
kīrtayiṣyati no nāma yathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām .. 9 ..
5.138.d:
तथास्य भूतले लोको नैव पूजां विधास्यति ..
कीर्तयिष्यति नो नाम यथान्येषां दिवौकसाम् .. 9 ..
5.138.m: “Likewise, on the surface of the earth, people will not worship him at all, / nor praise his name, as [they do] for other celestial beings.”

5.138.s:
yaḥ kaścitprātarutthāya nāma cāsya grahī ṣyati ..
maṃgalyakaraṇe cātha vighnaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati .. 6.139.10 ..
5.138.d:
यः कश्चित्प्रातरुत्थाय नाम चास्य ग्रही ष्यति ..
मंगल्यकरणे चाथ विघ्नं तस्य भविष्यति .. 6.139.10 ..
5.138.m: “Whoever, having risen in the morning, speaks his name / shall meet an obstacle in the performing of auspicious acts.”

5.138.s:
taṃ śrutvā tasya viprasya yamaḥ śāpaṃ sudāruṇam ..
svadharme vartamānastu tato duḥkhā nvito'bhavat .. 11 ..
5.138.d:
तं श्रुत्वा तस्य विप्रस्य यमः शापं सुदारुणम् ..
स्वधर्मे वर्तमानस्तु ततो दुःखा न्वितोऽभवत् .. 11 ..
5.138.m: Having heard that very terrible curse of the brahmin, / Yama, though abiding by his own duty, became overcome with sorrow.

5.138.s:
etasminnaṃtare gatvā brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ prati ..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā yamaḥ prāha pitāmaham .. 12 ..
5.138.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे गत्वा ब्रह्मणः सदनं प्रति ..
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा यमः प्राह पितामहम् .. 12 ..
5.138.m: In the meantime, having gone to the abode of Brahmā, / folding his hands in reverence, Yama said to the Grandfather:

5.138.s:
paśya deveśa śapto'haṃ nirdoṣopi dvijanmanā ..
svadharme vartamānastu yathānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ .. 13 ..
5.138.d:
पश्य देवेश शप्तोऽहं निर्दोषोपि द्विजन्मना ..
स्वधर्मे वर्तमानस्तु यथान्यः प्राकृतो जनः .. 13 ..
5.138.m: “Behold, O Lord of gods! I have been cursed by a twice-born, though faultless / and abiding by my own duty, as if I were some common person!”

5.138.s:
tasmādahaṃ tyajiṣyāmi niyogaṃ te pitāmaha ..
brahmaśāpabhayā dbhītaḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 14 ..
5.138.d:
तस्मादहं त्यजिष्यामि नियोगं ते पितामह ..
ब्रह्मशापभया द्भीतः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 14 ..
5.138.m: “Therefore, I shall abandon your appointment, O Grandfather! / I am terrified of the fear of a brahmin's curse; this is the truth spoken by me.”

5.138.s:
purā māṃḍavyaśāpena śūdrayonyavatāritaḥ ..
sāṃprataṃ putrarahitaḥ kṛto'pūjyaśca sattama .. 15 ..
5.138.d:
पुरा मांडव्यशापेन शूद्रयोन्यवतारितः ..
सांप्रतं पुत्ररहितः कृतोऽपूज्यश्च सत्तम .. 15 ..
5.138.m: “Formerly, by the curse of Māṇḍavya, I was made to descend into the womb of a Śūdra; / now I have been rendered devoid of sons and unworthy of worship, O best of beings!”

5.138.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dīnaṃ vaivasvatasya ca ..
tatkālocitamāhedaṃ svayameva śatakratuḥ .. 16 ..
5.138.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दीनं वैवस्वतस्य च ..
तत्कालोचितमाहेदं स्वयमेव शतक्रतुः .. 16 ..
5.138.m: Sūta said: / Hearing those plaintive words of the son of Vivasvat, / Śatakratu himself spoke this, fitting for that occasion:

5.138.s:
yuktamuktamanenaitaddharmarājena padmaja ..
niyoge vartamānena tāvakīye sureśvara .. 17 ..
5.138.d:
युक्तमुक्तमनेनैतद्धर्मराजेन पद्मज ..
नियोगे वर्तमानेन तावकीये सुरेश्वर .. 17 ..
5.138.m: “What has been spoken by this Dharmarāja is fitting, O lotus-born one, / as he abides by your command, O Lord of the gods!”

5.138.s:
avaśyameva martye ca manuṣyāḥ samaye sthitāḥ..
bālye vā yauvane vātha vārdhakye vā pitāmaha ..
saṃhartavyā na saṃdeho nākāle ca kathaṃcana .. 18 ..
5.138.d:
अवश्यमेव मर्त्ये च मनुष्याः समये स्थिताः..
बाल्ये वा यौवने वाथ वार्धक्ये वा पितामह ..
संहर्तव्या न संदेहो नाकाले च कथंचन .. 18 ..
5.138.m: In the mortal world, men whose time has come must certainly / be gathered in, whether in childhood, youth, or old age, O Grandfather; / of this there is no doubt, but never before their time.

5.138.s:
etadeva kṛtaṃ nāma dharmarājākhyamuttamam ..
tvayā ca samamitrasya samaśastrormahātmanaḥ .. 19 ..
5.138.d:
एतदेव कृतं नाम धर्मराजाख्यमुत्तमम् ..
त्वया च सममित्रस्य समशस्त्रोर्महात्मनः .. 19 ..
5.138.m: For this very reason, the noble title 'King of Dharma' was given / by you to this great-souled one, who views friend and foe alike.

5.138.s:
tasmādadya samālokya kaścideva viciṃtyatām ..
upāyo yena nirdoṣo niyogaṃ kurute tava .. 6.139.20 ..
5.138.d:
तस्मादद्य समालोक्य कश्चिदेव विचिंत्यताम् ..
उपायो येन निर्दोषो नियोगं कुरुते तव .. 6.139.20 ..
5.138.m: Therefore, consider the matter today and devise some means / whereby, free of fault, he may carry out your charge."

5.138.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
brahmaśāpaṃ na śakto'ha manyathākartumevaca ..
upāyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ tridaśādhipa .. 21 ..
5.138.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मशापं न शक्तोऽह मन्यथाकर्तुमेवच ..
उपायं च करिष्यामि सांप्रतं त्रिदशाधिप .. 21 ..
5.138.m: Brahmā said: / "I am not able to undo a brahmin's curse; / yet I shall now devise a means, O lord of the thirty [gods]."

5.138.s:
tato dhyānaṃ pracakre sa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
tadarthaṃ sarvadevānāṃ purataḥ susa māhitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.138.d:
ततो ध्यानं प्रचक्रे स ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
तदर्थं सर्वदेवानां पुरतः सुस माहितः .. 22 ..
5.138.m: Then Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, deeply composed, / entered into meditation for that purpose before all the gods.

5.138.s:
tasyaivaṃ dhyānasaktasya prādurbhūtāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
mūrtā rogāḥ suraudrāste vātagulmakaphātmakāḥ ..
aṣṭottaraśataprāyāḥ procustaṃ ca kṛtādarāḥ .. 23 ..
5.138.d:
तस्यैवं ध्यानसक्तस्य प्रादुर्भूताः समंततः ..
मूर्ता रोगाः सुरौद्रास्ते वातगुल्मकफात्मकाः ..
अष्टोत्तरशतप्रायाः प्रोचुस्तं च कृतादराः .. 23 ..
5.138.m: As he was thus absorbed in meditation, there manifested on all sides / embodied diseases, exceedingly dreadful, of the nature of wind, spleen, and phlegm; / roughly one hundred and eight, and paying homage, they said to him:

5.138.s:
.. rogā ūcuḥ .. ..
kimarthaṃ devadeveśa tvayā sṛṣṭā vayaṃ vibho ..
ādeśo dīyatāṃ śīghraṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti .. 24 .. ..
5.138.d:
.. रोगा ऊचुः .. ..
किमर्थं देवदेवेश त्वया सृष्टा वयं विभो ..
आदेशो दीयतां शीघ्रं प्रसादः क्रियतामिति .. 24 .. ..
5.138.m: The diseases said: / "For what purpose, O lord of the god of gods, have we been created by you, O omnipresent one? / Give your order quickly, and bestow your favor!"

5.138.s:
.. vrahmovāca .. ..
vrajadhvaṃ bhūtale śīghraṃ mamādeśādasaṃśayam ..
yamādeśānmanuṣyeṣu gantavyamavikalpitam .. 25 ..
5.138.d:
.. व्रह्मोवाच .. ..
व्रजध्वं भूतले शीघ्रं ममादेशादसंशयम् ..
यमादेशान्मनुष्येषु गन्तव्यमविकल्पितम् .. 25 ..
5.138.m: Brahmā said: / "Go swiftly to the surface of the earth by my command, without doubt. / At the order of Yama, you must go among mortals without hesitation."

5.138.s:
evamukttvā tu tānrogāṃstataḥ prāha pitāmahaḥ ..
dharmarājaṃ samīpasthaṃ bhṛśaṃ dīnamadhomukham .. 26
5.138.d:
एवमुक्त्त्वा तु तान्रोगांस्ततः प्राह पितामहः ..
धर्मराजं समीपस्थं भृशं दीनमधोमुखम् .. 26
5.138.m: Having spoken thus to the diseases, the Grandfather then addressed / the King of Dharma, who was standing nearby, deeply downcast and with head bowed:

5.138.s:
ete te vyādhayaḥ sarve mayā yama niyojitāḥ ..
sāhāyyaṃ ca kariṣyaṃti sarvakṛ tyeṣu sarvadā ..27..
5.138.d:
एते ते व्याधयः सर्वे मया यम नियोजिताः ..
साहाय्यं च करिष्यंति सर्वकृ त्येषु सर्वदा ..27..
5.138.m: "All these diseases have been appointed by me for you, O Yama; / they will render assistance to you in all tasks at all times.

5.138.s:
yaḥ kaścidadhunā martyo gatāyuḥ saṃprapadyate ..
vadhāya tasya yatnena tvayā preṣyāḥ sadaiva tu..28..
5.138.d:
यः कश्चिदधुना मर्त्यो गतायुः संप्रपद्यते ..
वधाय तस्य यत्नेन त्वया प्रेष्याः सदैव तु..28..
5.138.m: Whatever mortal now has reached the end of his lifespan, / you must constantly send them with care for his destruction.

5.138.s:
eteṣāṃ jāyate tena jananāśasamudbhavaḥ ..
apavādo dharāpṛṣṭhe na ca saṃjāyate tava ..29..
tasmādgatvā nijaṃ sthānaṃ svādhikāraparo bhava ..
mamādeśādasaṃdigdhaṃ naivaṃ doṣamavāpsyasi..6.139.3...
5.138.d:
एतेषां जायते तेन जननाशसमुद्भवः ..
अपवादो धरापृष्ठे न च संजायते तव ..29..
तस्माद्गत्वा निजं स्थानं स्वाधिकारपरो भव ..
ममादेशादसंदिग्धं नैवं दोषमवाप्स्यसि..6.139.3...
5.138.m:
Thereby the blame for the destruction of people will fall upon them, / and no reproach will come upon you on the surface of the earth.
Therefore, go to your own abode and attend to your duty; / by my command, undoubtedly, you will incur no fault in this way."

5.138.s:
tatastānsakalānvyādhīngṛhītvā ravinaṃdanaḥ..
yamalokaṃ samāsādya tataḥ provāca sādaram .. 31 ..
5.138.d:
ततस्तान्सकलान्व्याधीन्गृहीत्वा रविनंदनः..
यमलोकं समासाद्य ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 31 ..
5.138.m: Then, taking all those diseases, the son of the sun / reached Yamaloka and then respectfully said:

5.138.s:
pṛṣṭvāpṛṣṭvā ca gaṃtavyaṃ citraguptaṃ dharātale ..
gaṃtavyaṃ jananāśāya samaye samupasthite .. 32 ..
5.138.d:
पृष्ट्वापृष्ट्वा च गंतव्यं चित्रगुप्तं धरातले ..
गंतव्यं जननाशाय समये समुपस्थिते .. 32 ..
5.138.m: "After repeatedly consulting Citragupta, you must go to the surface of the earth; / you must go for the destruction of people when the appointed time has arrived.

5.138.s:
paramasti mayā tatra sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam .
hāṭakeśvarajekṣetre sarvapātakanāśanam ..33..
5.138.d:
परमस्ति मया तत्र स्थापितं लिंगमुत्तमम् .
हाटकेश्वरजेक्षेत्रे सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..33..
5.138.m: However, there is an excellent liṅga installed by me / in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, which destroys all sins.

5.138.s:
yastaṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..
sa yuṣmābhiḥ sadā tyājyo dūrato vacanānmama .. 34 ..
5.138.d:
यस्तं पश्यति सद्भक्त्या प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ..
स युष्माभिः सदा त्याज्यो दूरतो वचनान्मम .. 34 ..
5.138.m: Whatever man, having risen in the morning, beholds it with true devotion, / he must always be avoided by you from afar, by my word."

5.138.s:
evamuktvā sa tānvyādhīṃstato vaivasvataḥ svayam ..
tasya viprasya taṃ putraṃ gṛhītvā satvaraṃ yayau ..
tasyaiva maṃdire ramye kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvijanmanaḥ .. 35 ..
5.138.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स तान्व्याधींस्ततो वैवस्वतः स्वयम् ..
तस्य विप्रस्य तं पुत्रं गृहीत्वा सत्वरं ययौ ..
तस्यैव मंदिरे रम्ये कृत्वा रूपं द्विजन्मनः .. 35 ..
5.138.m: Having spoken thus to those diseases, the son of Vivasvat himself / quickly departed, taking that son of the brahmin with him / to his lovely home, having assumed the form of a twice-born.

5.138.s:
athāsau brāhmaṇo dṛṣṭvā svaṃ putraṃ gṛhamāgatam ..
sahitaṃ viprarūpeṇa dharmarājena dhīmatā .. 36 ..
5.138.d:
अथासौ ब्राह्मणो दृष्ट्वा स्वं पुत्रं गृहमागतम् ..
सहितं विप्ररूपेण धर्मराजेन धीमता .. 36 ..
5.138.m: Then that brahmin, seeing his son arrived home / accompanied by the wise King of Dharma in the guise of a brahmin,

5.138.s:
tataḥ prahṛṣṭacittena satvaraṃ sammukho yayau ..
putraputreti jalpansa nijabhāryāsamanvitaḥ .. 37 ..
5.138.d:
ततः प्रहृष्टचित्तेन सत्वरं सम्मुखो ययौ ..
पुत्रपुत्रेति जल्पन्स निजभार्यासमन्वितः .. 37 ..
5.138.m: hastened forward with a delighted heart, / crying out, "Son! Son!" together with his wife.

5.138.s:
pariṣvajya tato bhūyo vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ ..
āghrāya ca tato mūrdhni vākyametaduvāca ha .. 38 ..
5.138.d:
परिष्वज्य ततो भूयो वाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः ..
आघ्राय च ततो मूर्ध्नि वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 38 ..
5.138.m: Then, repeatedly embracing him, his eyes filled with tears, / and having smelled his head, he spoke these words:

5.138.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ putra samāyātastvaṃ tasmā dyamamaṃdirāt ..
na kaścitpunarāyāti yatra gatvā'pi vīryavān .. 39 ..
kiṃ vā caitatsamutpannamindrajālaṃ mamāṃtikam ..
kiṃ vā svapnamidaṃ kiṃ vā mamāyaṃ dṛṣṭivibhramaḥ ..6.139.4...
5.138.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
कथं पुत्र समायातस्त्वं तस्मा द्यममंदिरात् ..
न कश्चित्पुनरायाति यत्र गत्वाऽपि वीर्यवान् .. 39 ..
किं वा चैतत्समुत्पन्नमिन्द्रजालं ममांतिकम् ..
किं वा स्वप्नमिदं किं वा ममायं दृष्टिविभ्रमः ..6.139.4...
5.138.m:
The brahmin said: / "How, O son, have you returned from that abode of Yama, / from where no one, even a powerful man, ever returns?
Or has this illusion arisen before me? / Or is this a dream, or an aberration of my vision?

5.138.s:
kaścāyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pārśve tava saṃtiṣṭhate suta ..
divyena tejasā yuktastaṃ namāmyahamātmaja .. 41 ..
5.138.d:
कश्चायं ब्राह्मणः पार्श्वे तव संतिष्ठते सुत ..
दिव्येन तेजसा युक्तस्तं नमाम्यहमात्मज .. 41 ..
5.138.m: And who is this brahmin standing at your side, my son, / endowed with divine splendor? I bow to him, O child."

5.138.s:
.. putra uvāca .. ..
eṣa brāhmaṇarūpeṇa samāyāto yamaḥ svayam ..
māmādāya kṛpāviṣṭo jñātvā tvāṃ duḥkhasaṃyutam .. 42 ..
5.138.d:
.. पुत्र उवाच .. ..
एष ब्राह्मणरूपेण समायातो यमः स्वयम् ..
मामादाय कृपाविष्टो ज्ञात्वा त्वां दुःखसंयुतम् .. 42 ..
5.138.m: The son said: / "This is Yama himself, who has come in the form of a brahmin; / filled with compassion, he has brought me, knowing you were stricken with grief.

5.138.s:
tasmāttvaṃ kuru tātāsya śāpānugrahamadya vai..
gṛhaprāptasya susnehādyadyahaṃ tava vallabhaḥ .. 43 ..
5.138.d:
तस्मात्त्वं कुरु तातास्य शापानुग्रहमद्य वै..
गृहप्राप्तस्य सुस्नेहाद्यद्यहं तव वल्लभः .. 43 ..
5.138.m: Therefore, O father, grant him today the mitigation of your curse / with great affection, as he has reached your home, if I am dear to you."

5.138.s:
tatastasya praṇāmaṃ sa kṛtvā brāhmaṇasattamaḥ ..
vrīḍayā'dhomukho bhūtvā tataḥ provāca sādaram .. 44 .. ..
5.138.d:
ततस्तस्य प्रणामं स कृत्वा ब्राह्मणसत्तमः ..
व्रीडयाऽधोमुखो भूत्वा ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 44 .. ..
5.138.m: Then that best of brahmins, having bowed down to him, / lowered his head with shame and then spoke respectfully:

5.138.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ..
yatputrasya mama prāptirgatasya yamasādanam . 45 ..
5.138.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम् ..
यत्पुत्रस्य मम प्राप्तिर्गतस्य यमसादनम् . 45 ..
5.138.m: The brahmin said: / "Today my birth is fruitful, and my life is well-lived, / since my son, who had gone to the abode of Yama, has been restored.

5.138.s:
tvaṃ ca putrakṛte tāta santoṣaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
tasmātputreṇa saṃyukto yathāyaṃ syāttathā kuru .. 46 ..
5.138.d:
त्वं च पुत्रकृते तात सन्तोषं परमं गतः ..
तस्मात्पुत्रेण संयुक्तो यथायं स्यात्तथा कुरु .. 46 ..
5.138.m: And you, O father, have attained the highest satisfaction on account of my son; / therefore, act in such a way that he may remain united with his son."

5.138.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
na me syādanṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kadā cidapi putraka ..
api svaireṇa yatproktaṃ kiṃ punarduḥkhitena ca .. 47 ..
5.138.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
न मे स्यादनृतं वाक्यं कदा चिदपि पुत्रक ..
अपि स्वैरेण यत्प्रोक्तं किं पुनर्दुःखितेन च .. 47 ..
5.138.m: The brahmin said: / "My word can never be false, O dear son, / even when spoken at random, much less when spoken in grief.

5.138.s:
tasmāttasya bhavetputro daivayonisamudbhavaḥ ..
na kathaṃcidapi prājña mama śāpavaśāddhruvam.. 48 ..
5.138.d:
तस्मात्तस्य भवेत्पुत्रो दैवयोनिसमुद्भवः ..
न कथंचिदपि प्राज्ञ मम शापवशाद्ध्रुवम्.. 48 ..
5.138.m: Therefore, a son born of a divine womb can by no means / be born to him, O wise one, firmly due to the power of my curse.

5.138.s:
bhaviṣyati sutaścānyo mānuṣīyonisaṃbhavaḥ ..
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ yaścainaṃ tārayiṣyati .. 49 ..
5.138.d:
भविष्यति सुतश्चान्यो मानुषीयोनिसंभवः ..
राजसूयाश्वमेधाभ्यां यश्चैनं तारयिष्यति .. 49 ..
5.138.m: However, another son born of a human womb will come to be, / who will deliver him by means of the Rājasūya and the Aśvamedha.

5.138.s:
ko'rthaḥ putreṇa jātena yo na saṃtāraṇakṣamaḥ ..
pitṛpakṣaṃ śubhaṃ karma kṛtvā sarvottamaṃ bhuvi .. 6.139.50 ..
5.138.d:
कोऽर्थः पुत्रेण जातेन यो न संतारणक्षमः ..
पितृपक्षं शुभं कर्म कृत्वा सर्वोत्तमं भुवि .. 6.139.50 ..
5.138.m: What is the use of a son being born who is incapable of delivering / his paternal ancestors by performing auspicious actions, the best of all on earth?

5.138.s:
tathā pūjākṛte yo'sya śāpo dattaśca vai purā ..
tatrāpi śṛṇu me vākyaṃ tasya putraka jalpataḥ ..51..
5.138.d:
तथा पूजाकृते योऽस्य शापो दत्तश्च वै पुरा ..
तत्रापि शृणु मे वाक्यं तस्य पुत्रक जल्पतः ..51..
5.138.m: Moreover, regarding the curse that was previously given concerning his worship, / hear also my statement, O son, as he speaks:

5.138.s:
vedoktairvividhairmantrairyā pūjā cāsya saṃsthitā ..
na bhaviṣyati sā loke kathaṃcidapi putraka .. 52 ..
5.138.d:
वेदोक्तैर्विविधैर्मन्त्रैर्या पूजा चास्य संस्थिता ..
न भविष्यति सा लोके कथंचिदपि पुत्रक .. 52 ..
5.138.m: That worship of his which was established with various mantras spoken in the Vedas / shall not take place in the world in any manner, O son.

5.138.s:
asya mānuṣasaṃbhūtairmantraiḥ pūjā bhaviṣyati ..
viśiṣṭā sarvadevebhyaḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 53 ..
5.138.d:
अस्य मानुषसंभूतैर्मन्त्रैः पूजा भविष्यति ..
विशिष्टा सर्वदेवेभ्यः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 53 ..
5.138.m: His worship shall take place with mantras of human origin, / superior to all the gods; this truth has been declared by me."

5.138.s:
.. putra uvāca .. ..
ahamenaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya drijaśreṣṭha mahītale ..
samyagārādhayiṣyāmi kimanyairvibudhairmama .. 54 ..
5.138.d:
.. पुत्र उवाच .. ..
अहमेनं प्रतिष्ठाप्य द्रिजश्रेष्ठ महीतले ..
सम्यगाराधयिष्यामि किमन्यैर्विबुधैर्मम .. 54 ..
5.138.m: The son said: / "Having established him on the surface of the earth, O best of the twice-born, / I shall worship him properly; what need do I have of other gods?

5.138.s:
tasmātsaṃkīrtayiṣyāmi maṃtrānmānuṣasaṃbhavān ..
tathā pūjāvidhānaṃ ca tvatprasādena pūrvaja .. 55 ..
5.138.d:
तस्मात्संकीर्तयिष्यामि मंत्रान्मानुषसंभवान् ..
तथा पूजाविधानं च त्वत्प्रसादेन पूर्वज .. 55 ..
5.138.m: Therefore, I will recite mantras originating from humans, / as well as the procedure of worship, by your favor, O ancestor."

5.138.s:
tataḥ sugaṃ naḥ pantheti tasya maṃtraṃ vidhāya saḥ ..
samācaratprahṛṣṭātmā dharmarājasya śṛṇvataḥ .. 56 ..
5.138.d:
ततः सुगं नः पन्थेति तस्य मंत्रं विधाय सः ..
समाचरत्प्रहृष्टात्मा धर्मराजस्य शृण्वतः .. 56 ..
5.138.m: Then, having composed a mantra for him with the words "May our path be good," / he, delighted in soul, performed [the rite] while the King of Dharma listened.

5.138.s:
tacchrutvātha yamaḥ proccaiḥ suprasannena cetasā ..
taṃ brāhmaṇa muvācedaṃ harṣagadgadayāgirā .. 97 ..
.. yama uvāca .. ..
kathaṃcidapi vipredra na me syāddarśanaṃ vṛthā ..
anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ tasmātprārthaya vāṃchi tam .. 58 ..
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
tavārcāṃ mama putro'yaṃ sthāpayiṣyati yāmiha ..
tāmanenaiva maṃtreṇa yaḥ kaścitpūjayeddvijaḥ .. 59 ..
bhavetsaṃvatsaraṃ yāvatsaṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ..
mā tasya putraśoko hi iha loke kathañcana .. 6.139.60 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya saṃprahṛṣṭamanā yamaḥ ..
yamalokaṃ jagāmātha svādhikāraparo'bhavat.. 61 ..
so'pi brāhmaṇadāyādaḥ kṛtvā prāsādamuttamam ..
yamamārādhayāmāsa madhye saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ ..
pitrā coktena mantreṇa tenaiva vidhipūrvakam.. 62 ..
5.138.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वाथ यमः प्रोच्चैः सुप्रसन्नेन चेतसा ..
तं ब्राह्मण मुवाचेदं हर्षगद्गदयागिरा .. 97 ..
.. यम उवाच .. ..
कथंचिदपि विप्रेद्र न मे स्याद्दर्शनं वृथा ..
अन्येषामपि देवानां तस्मात्प्रार्थय वांछि तम् .. 58 ..
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
तवार्चां मम पुत्रोऽयं स्थापयिष्यति यामिह ..
तामनेनैव मंत्रेण यः कश्चित्पूजयेद्द्विजः .. 59 ..
भवेत्संवत्सरं यावत्संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने ..
मा तस्य पुत्रशोको हि इह लोके कथञ्चन .. 6.139.60 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय संप्रहृष्टमना यमः ..
यमलोकं जगामाथ स्वाधिकारपरोऽभवत्.. 61 ..
सोऽपि ब्राह्मणदायादः कृत्वा प्रासादमुत्तमम् ..
यममाराधयामास मध्ये संस्थाप्य भक्तितः ..
पित्रा चोक्तेन मन्त्रेण तेनैव विधिपूर्वकम्.. 62 ..
5.138.m:
Hearing that, Yama, highly pleased in his heart, / spoke thus to that brahmin in a voice choked with joy:
Yama said: / "By no means, O prince of brahmins, should the sight of me, / or of the other gods, be in vain; therefore, request what you desire."
The brahmin said:
Whatever image of you this son of mine shall establish here, / whichever twice-born [man] worships it with this very mantra,
for the duration of a year, when the fifth day arrives, / may he suffer no grief for a son whatsoever in this world.
Sūta said:
Having promised, "So be it," Yama, with a rejoiced heart, / then went to the world of Yama and became intent upon his own office.
That son of the brahmin also, having built an excellent temple, / worshipped Yama, having installed [him] in the middle with devotion, / by means of that very mantra spoken by his father, according to ritual rules.

5.138.s:
tataśca kramaśaḥ prāpya putrapautrānanekaśaḥ ..
kāladharmamanuprāptaściraṃ sthitvā mahītale .. 63 ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ purāṇeyatpurā śrutam..
yaścaitatkīrtayedbhaktyā saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ..
nāpamṛtyurbhavettasya na ca śokaḥ sutodbhavaḥ .. 64 ..
5.138.d:
ततश्च क्रमशः प्राप्य पुत्रपौत्राननेकशः ..
कालधर्ममनुप्राप्तश्चिरं स्थित्वा महीतले .. 63 ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं पुराणेयत्पुरा श्रुतम्..
यश्चैतत्कीर्तयेद्भक्त्या संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने ..
नापमृत्युर्भवेत्तस्य न च शोकः सुतोद्भवः .. 64 ..
5.138.m:
And then, having attained many sons and grandsons in succession, / he met the law of time after remaining long on the surface of the earth.
All this, which was heard long ago in the Purāṇa, has been narrated to you. / Whoever recites this with devotion when the fifth day arrives, / will suffer no premature death, nor grief arising from a son.

5.138.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahapurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dharmarājeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 139 .. .. cha ..
5.138.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महपुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धर्मराजेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशदुत्तर शततमोऽध्यायः .. 139 .. .. छ ..
5.138.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Māhātmya of Dharmarājeśvara," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skanda Purāṇa.

5.139.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ putro mānuṣavigrahaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati yamasyātra kaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sa sūtaja .. 1 ..
5.139.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं पुत्रो मानुषविग्रहः ..
भविष्यति यमस्यात्र कः संभूतः स सूतज .. 1 ..
5.139.m:
The seers said:
Regarding what was spoken by you: "A son with a human form / will be born to Yama here"—who was he that was born, O son of Sūta?

5.139.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya putraḥ samutpannaḥ pāṃḍoḥ kṣetre mahītale ..
yudhiṣṭhira iti khyātaḥ sarvakṣatriyapuṃgavaḥ .. 2 ..
5.139.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य पुत्रः समुत्पन्नः पांडोः क्षेत्रे महीतले ..
युधिष्ठिर इति ख्यातः सर्वक्षत्रियपुंगवः .. 2 ..
5.139.m:
Sūta said:
His son was born on the surface of the earth in the field of Pāṇḍu, / renowned as Yudhiṣṭhira, the foremost of all kṣatriyas,

5.139.s:
rājasūyo makho yena iṣṭaḥ sampūrṇadakṣiṇaḥ ..
sarvānbhūmipatīnvīryātsaṃvidhāya karapradān .. 3 ..
5.139.d:
राजसूयो मखो येन इष्टः सम्पूर्णदक्षिणः ..
सर्वान्भूमिपतीन्वीर्यात्संविधाय करप्रदान् .. 3 ..
5.139.m: by whom the Rājasūya sacrifice was offered with complete sacrificial fees, / having reduced all rulers of the earth to tribute-payers by his valour.

5.139.s:
aśvamedhāḥ kṛtāḥ paṃca tathā sampūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ ..
bhrāmayitvā hayaṃ bhūmau paścātprāpa sa sadgatim .. 4 ..
5.139.d:
अश्वमेधाः कृताः पंच तथा सम्पूर्णदक्षिणाः ..
भ्रामयित्वा हयं भूमौ पश्चात्प्राप स सद्गतिम् .. 4 ..
5.139.m: Five horse-sacrifices were performed [by him], likewise with complete sacrificial fees; / after making the horse wander over the earth, he later attained the good destination.

5.139.s:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyekopi gayāṃ vrajet ..
yajeta vā'śvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet .. 5 ..
5.139.d:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोपि गयां व्रजेत् ..
यजेत वाऽश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत् .. 5 ..
5.139.m: Many sons are to be desired, [hoping] that even one might go to Gayā, / or offer a horse-sacrifice, or release a dark blue bull.

5.139.s:
yadanena vṛtaṃ mattaḥ putritvaṃ sumahātmanā ..
hayamedhānmahāyajñānkartā syādasya vai sutaḥ .. 6 ..
5.139.d:
यदनेन वृतं मत्तः पुत्रित्वं सुमहात्मना ..
हयमेधान्महायज्ञान्कर्ता स्यादस्य वै सुतः .. 6 ..
5.139.m: Since sonship was sought from me by that very great-souled one, / his son indeed became the performer of the great sacrifices, the horse-sacrifices.

5.139.s:
manyeta kṛtakṛtyatvaṃ yena putreṇa dharmapaḥ ..
anyaiḥ putraśataiḥ kiṃ vā vaṃśānuddhārakārakaiḥ .. 7 ..
5.139.d:
मन्येत कृतकृत्यत्वं येन पुत्रेण धर्मपः ..
अन्यैः पुत्रशतैः किं वा वंशानुद्धारकारकैः .. 7 ..
5.139.m: The guardian of dharma would consider himself accomplished of purpose by such a son; / or what use are hundreds of other sons who do not rescue their lineage?

5.139.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ dharmarājasutodbhavam ..
ākhyānaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā dharmavṛddhikaraṃ param .. 8 .. .
5.139.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं धर्मराजसुतोद्भवम् ..
आख्यानं ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा धर्मवृद्धिकरं परम् .. 8 .. .
5.139.m:
Sūta said:
All this narrative of the birth of the son of Dharmarāja, / which brings about an increase of dharma in the highest degree, has been related to you, O best of brahmins.

5.139.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dharmarājaputrākhyānavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśaduttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 140 ..
5.139.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धर्मराजपुत्राख्यानवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशदुत्तर शततमोऽध्यायः .. 140 ..
5.139.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fortieth chapter, entitled "Description of the Narrative of Dharmarāja's Son," in the Māhātmya of the glorious Hāṭakeśvara Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skanda Purāṇa.

5.140.s:
.. sūtauvāca .. ..
tathānyo'pi hi tatrāsti devo miṣṭānnadāyakaḥ ..
yasya saṃdarśanādeva miṣṭānnaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 1 ..
5.140.d:
.. सूतौवाच .. ..
तथान्योऽपि हि तत्रास्ति देवो मिष्टान्नदायकः ..
यस्य संदर्शनादेव मिष्टान्नं लभते नरः .. 1 ..
5.140.m:
Sūta said:
Likewise, there is also another deity there who grants sweet food, / from whose mere darśana a man obtains sweet food.

5.140.s:
āsītpūrvaṃ nṛpo nāmnā vasusena iti smṛtaḥ ..
ānarttādhipatiḥ khyāto bṛhatkalpe dvijottamāḥ .. 2 ..
5.140.d:
आसीत्पूर्वं नृपो नाम्ना वसुसेन इति स्मृतः ..
आनर्त्ताधिपतिः ख्यातो बृहत्कल्पे द्विजोत्तमाः .. 2 ..
5.140.m: In the past, O best of the twice-born, there was a king known by the name of Vasusena, / renowned as the ruler of Ānarta in the Bṛhatkalpa.

5.140.s:
atyaiśvaryasamāyukto gajavājirathānvitaḥ ..
jitāripakṣastejasvī dātā bhogī jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 3 ..
5.140.d:
अत्यैश्वर्यसमायुक्तो गजवाजिरथान्वितः ..
जितारिपक्षस्तेजस्वी दाता भोगी जितेंद्रियः .. 3 ..
5.140.m: He was endowed with great sovereignty, possessed elephants, horses, and chariots, / was one who conquered enemy factions, was radiant, generous, an enjoyer of pleasures, and self-restrained.

5.140.s:
sa saṃkrāṃtau vyatīpāte grahaṇe ravi somayoḥ ..
parvakāleṣu cānyeṣu vividheṣu subhaktitaḥ .. 4 ..
5.140.d:
स संक्रांतौ व्यतीपाते ग्रहणे रवि सोमयोः ..
पर्वकालेषु चान्येषु विविधेषु सुभक्तितः .. 4 ..
5.140.m: At a solstice, at a vyatīpāta, during an eclipse of the sun and moon, / and on various other festival days, with great devotion,

5.140.s:
prayacchati dvijātibhyo ratnāni vividhāni ca ..
iṃdranīlamahānīlavidrumasphaṭikādi ca .. 5 ..
5.140.d:
प्रयच्छति द्विजातिभ्यो रत्नानि विविधानि च ..
इंद्रनीलमहानीलविद्रुमस्फटिकादि च .. 5 ..
5.140.m: he would give diverse gems to the twice-born: / sapphire, large sapphire, coral, crystal, and so forth,

5.140.s:
māṇikyamauktikānyeva vidrumāṇi viśeṣataḥ ..
hastyaśvarathayānāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca .. 6 ..
5.140.d:
माणिक्यमौक्तिकान्येव विद्रुमाणि विशेषतः ..
हस्त्यश्वरथयानानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च .. 6 ..
5.140.m: rubies and pearls indeed, especially corals, / vehicles of elephants, horses, and chariots, and diverse clothes.

5.140.s:
na kasyacitpradadyātsa sasyaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
atīva sulabhaṃ matvā tathā toyaṃ viśeṣataḥ.. 7 ..
5.140.d:
न कस्यचित्प्रदद्यात्स सस्यं ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
अतीव सुलभं मत्वा तथा तोयं विशेषतः.. 7 ..
5.140.m: He would not give grain to anyone, O best of brahmins, / nor water especially, considering it exceedingly easily obtained.

5.140.s:
tato rājyaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā putrodbhavānsutān ..
kāladharmamanuprāptaḥ kasmiṃścitkālaparyaye .. 8 ..
5.140.d:
ततो राज्यं चिरं कृत्वा दृष्ट्वा पुत्रोद्भवान्सुतान् ..
कालधर्ममनुप्राप्तः कस्मिंश्चित्कालपर्यये .. 8 ..
5.140.m: Then, having ruled for a long time and seen the sons born of his sons, / he met the law of time at a certain turn of time.

5.140.s:
tataśca maṃtribhistasya satyasena iti smṛtaḥ ..
abhiṣiktaḥ suto rājye vīryodāryasamanvitaḥ .. 9 ..
5.140.d:
ततश्च मंत्रिभिस्तस्य सत्यसेन इति स्मृतः ..
अभिषिक्तः सुतो राज्ये वीर्योदार्यसमन्वितः .. 9 ..
5.140.m: And then, his son known as Satyasena, endowed with valour and magnanimity, / was consecrated in the kingdom by his ministers.

5.140.s:
vasuseno'pi saṃprāpya svargaṃ dānaprabhāvataḥ ..
divyāṃbaradharo bhūtvā divyaratnairvibhūṣitaḥ .. 6.141.10 ..
5.140.d:
वसुसेनोऽपि संप्राप्य स्वर्गं दानप्रभावतः ..
दिव्यांबरधरो भूत्वा दिव्यरत्नैर्विभूषितः .. 6.141.10 ..
5.140.m: Vasusena too, having attained heaven by the power of his giving, / wearing celestial garments and adorned with celestial jewels,

5.140.s:
sevyamāno'psarobhiśca vimānavaramāśritaḥ ..
babhrāma sarvalokeṣu svecchayā kṣutsamāvṛtaḥ .. 11 ..
5.140.d:
सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोभिश्च विमानवरमाश्रितः ..
बभ्राम सर्वलोकेषु स्वेच्छया क्षुत्समावृतः .. 11 ..
5.140.m: attended by apsarases and mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot, / roamed through all the worlds at will, overcome by hunger.

5.140.s:
pipāsākulacittaśca mukhena pariśuṣyatā ..
na kaṃciddadṛśe tatra bhuṃjānamaparaṃ divi .. 12 .
5.140.d:
पिपासाकुलचित्तश्च मुखेन परिशुष्यता ..
न कंचिद्ददृशे तत्र भुंजानमपरं दिवि .. 12 .
5.140.m: His mind distressed by thirst, and with a parched mouth, / he saw no one else there in heaven eating,

5.140.s: na ca pānasamāsaktaṃ na sasyaṃ salilaṃ na ca .. 13 ..
5.140.d: न च पानसमासक्तं न सस्यं सलिलं न च .. 13 ..
5.140.m: nor attached to drinking, nor [did he see] grain or water.

5.140.s:
tato gatvā sahasrākṣamuvāca dvijasattamāḥ ..
kṣuttṛṣāvṛtadehastu lajjayā'dhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 14 ..
5.140.d:
ततो गत्वा सहस्राक्षमुवाच द्विजसत्तमाः ..
क्षुत्तृषावृतदेहस्तु लज्जयाऽधोमुखः स्थितः .. 14 ..
5.140.m: Then, having gone to the thousand-eyed one, O best of the twice-born, / with a body seized by hunger and thirst, he stood with his face turned downwards in shame, and said:

5.140.s:
naivātra dṛśyate kaścitkṣuttṛṣāparipīḍitaḥ ..
māṃ muktvā vibudhaśreṣṭha tatkimetadvadasvame .. 15 ..
5.140.d:
नैवात्र दृश्यते कश्चित्क्षुत्तृषापरिपीडितः ..
मां मुक्त्वा विबुधश्रेष्ठ तत्किमेतद्वदस्वमे .. 15 ..
5.140.m: "No one here is seen afflicted with hunger and thirst / except me, O best of the gods; therefore, tell me, what is this?

5.140.s:
eṣa me svargarūpeṇa narakaḥ samupasthitaḥ ..
kimetairbhūṣaṇairvastrairvimānādibhireva ca .. 16 ..
5.140.d:
एष मे स्वर्गरूपेण नरकः समुपस्थितः ..
किमेतैर्भूषणैर्वस्त्रैर्विमानादिभिरेव च .. 16 ..
5.140.m: This hell has appeared before me in the form of heaven! / What use are these ornaments, garments, aerial chariots, and the like?

5.140.s:
kṣudhā saṃpīḍyamānasya svargametacchacīpate ..
agnitulyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ mama citte'pi vartate .. 17 ..
5.140.d:
क्षुधा संपीड्यमानस्य स्वर्गमेतच्छचीपते ..
अग्नितुल्यं समुद्दिष्टं मम चित्तेऽपि वर्तते .. 17 ..
5.140.m: For me, afflicted with hunger, O lord of Śacī, this heaven / is declared to be equal to fire, and it remains [so] in my mind.

5.140.s:
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā kṣunna prabādhate ..
nocetkṣipa suraśreṣṭha raurave narake drutam ..18.. ..
5.140.d:
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे यथा क्षुन्न प्रबाधते ..
नोचेत्क्षिप सुरश्रेष्ठ रौरवे नरके द्रुतम् ..18.. ..
5.140.m: Therefore, grant me a favor so that hunger does not torment me; / otherwise, O best of the gods, cast me quickly into the Raurava hell!"

5.140.s:
.. iṃdrauvāca .. ..
anarhosi mahīpāla narakasya tvameva hi ..
tvayā dānāni dattāni saṃkhyāhīnāni sarvadā..19..
paraṃ kiṃ tu kvacinnānnaṃ dattaṃ rājanna codakam..
na kiṃcidapi saṃciṃtya yataḥ sulabhameva hi ..6.141.2...
5.140.d:
.. इंद्रौवाच .. ..
अनर्होसि महीपाल नरकस्य त्वमेव हि ..
त्वया दानानि दत्तानि संख्याहीनानि सर्वदा..19..
परं किं तु क्वचिन्नान्नं दत्तं राजन्न चोदकम्..
न किंचिदपि संचिंत्य यतः सुलभमेव हि ..6.141.2...
5.140.m:
Indra said:
O king, you indeed are not worthy of hell; / countless gifts were given by you at all times.
Yet, O king, food was never given, nor was water, / thinking of it as nothing at all, because it was so easily obtained.

5.140.s:
toyaṃ sānnaṃ sadā dadyādannaṃ caiva sadakṣiṇam..
ya icchecchāśvatīṃ tṛptimiha loke paratra ca .. 21 ..
5.140.d:
तोयं सान्नं सदा दद्यादन्नं चैव सदक्षिणम्..
य इच्छेच्छाश्वतीं तृप्तिमिह लोके परत्र च .. 21 ..
5.140.m: One should always give water with food, and food with a sacrificial fee, / if one desires perpetual satisfaction in this world and in the next.

5.140.s:
tasmāttvaṃ hi kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ svarge caiva mahīpate ..
bhūṣito bhūṣaṇaiḥ śreṣṭhairvimānavaramāśritaḥ .. 22 ..
5.140.d:
तस्मात्त्वं हि क्षुधाविष्टः स्वर्गे चैव महीपते ..
भूषितो भूषणैः श्रेष्ठैर्विमानवरमाश्रितः .. 22 ..
5.140.m: Therefore, O king, you are seized by hunger even in heaven, / adorned with excellent ornaments and mounted on an excellent aerial chariot.

5.140.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
asti kaścidupāyo'tra devau vā mānuṣo'pi vā ..
kṣutpipāse'titīvre me vināśaṃ yena gacchataḥ ..23..
5.140.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
अस्ति कश्चिदुपायोऽत्र देवौ वा मानुषोऽपि वा ..
क्षुत्पिपासेऽतितीव्रे मे विनाशं येन गच्छतः ..23..
5.140.m:
The king said:
Is there any means here, whether divine or human, / by which my severe hunger and thirst might be destroyed?

5.140.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
yadi kaścitsutastubhyaṃ viprebhyaḥ satataṃ jalam..
dadāti ca sadā sasyaṃ tatte tṛptiḥ prajāyate .. 24 ..
5.140.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
यदि कश्चित्सुतस्तुभ्यं विप्रेभ्यः सततं जलम्..
ददाति च सदा सस्यं तत्ते तृप्तिः प्रजायते .. 24 ..
5.140.m:
Indra said:
If any son of yours constantly gives water to brahmins / and always gives grain, then satisfaction will arise for you;

5.140.s:
nānyathā pārthivaśreṣṭha ekasminnapi vāsare ..
adattasya tava prāptiḥ satyametanmayoditam ..25..
5.140.d:
नान्यथा पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ एकस्मिन्नपि वासरे ..
अदत्तस्य तव प्राप्तिः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..25..
5.140.m: otherwise, O best of rulers, not even on a single day / can there be acquisition of what was not given by you. This truth is spoken by me.

5.140.s:
so'pi bhūmipateḥ putrastava yacchati nodakam..
na ca sasyaṃ dvijātibhyastvanmārgamanusaṃcaran..26..
5.140.d:
सोऽपि भूमिपतेः पुत्रस्तव यच्छति नोदकम्..
न च सस्यं द्विजातिभ्यस्त्वन्मार्गमनुसंचरन्..26..
5.140.m: Even that son of yours, O king, gives neither water / nor grain to the twice-born, following your path.

5.140.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto nārado munisattamaḥ..
brahmalokātsthitau yatra tau bhūmipasureśvarau .. 27 ..
5.140.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो नारदो मुनिसत्तमः..
ब्रह्मलोकात्स्थितौ यत्र तौ भूमिपसुरेश्वरौ .. 27 ..
5.140.m: At that moment arrived Nārada, the best of sages, / from Brahmaloka, where those two, the king and the lord of the gods, were staying.

5.140.s:
tataḥ śakraḥ samutthāya tasmai tuṣṭisamanvitaḥ ..
arghaṃ dattvā vidhānena sādaraṃ cedamabravīt .ār 28 ..
5.140.d:
ततः शक्रः समुत्थाय तस्मै तुष्टिसमन्वितः ..
अर्घं दत्त्वा विधानेन सादरं चेदमब्रवीत् .आर् 28 ..
5.140.m: Then Śakra rose, and filled with joy, / offered him the guest water according to the prescribed rules, and respectfully said:

5.140.s:
kutaḥ prāpto'si vipreṃdra prasthitaḥ kva ca sāṃpratam..
kena kāryeṇa cedguhyaṃ na te'sti vada sāṃpratam.. 29 ..
5.140.d:
कुतः प्राप्तोऽसि विप्रेंद्र प्रस्थितः क्व च सांप्रतम्..
केन कार्येण चेद्गुह्यं न तेऽस्ति वद सांप्रतम्.. 29 ..
5.140.m: "From where have you arrived, O leader of brahmins, and where are you bound now? / For what purpose, and if it is not secret, tell me now."

5.140.s:
nārada uvāca .. ..
brahmalokādahaṃ prāptaḥ prasthitastu dharātale ..
tīrthayātrākṛte śakra nānyadastīha kāraṇam .. 6.141.30 ..
5.140.d:
नारद उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मलोकादहं प्राप्तः प्रस्थितस्तु धरातले ..
तीर्थयात्राकृते शक्र नान्यदस्तीह कारणम् .. 6.141.30 ..
5.140.m: Nārada said: / "I have come from Brahmaloka and am headed for the surface of the earth / for the purpose of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, O Śakra; there is no other reason here."

5.140.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā sa nṛpo hṛṣṭastamuvāca munīśvaram ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ dīnasya munipuṃgava .. 31 ..
5.140.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा स नृपो हृष्टस्तमुवाच मुनीश्वरम् ..
प्रसादः क्रियतां मह्यं दीनस्य मुनिपुंगव .. 31 ..
5.140.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that, the king was delighted and said to that lord of sages: / "Bestow favor upon me, a wretched person, O best of sages!

5.140.s:
tvayā bhūmitale vācyo mama putro mahīpatiḥ ..
ānarttādhipatiḥ khyātaḥ satyasena iti prabho .. .. 32 ..
5.140.d:
त्वया भूमितले वाच्यो मम पुत्रो महीपतिः ..
आनर्त्ताधिपतिः ख्यातः सत्यसेन इति प्रभो .. .. 32 ..
5.140.m: You must tell my son, the king on the surface of the earth / known as the ruler of Ānarta, [named] Satyasena, O lord:

5.140.s:
tava tāto mayā dṛṣṭaḥ śakrasya sadanaṃ prati ..
kṣutpipāsāparītāṃgo dīnātmā devamadhyagaḥ .. 33 ..
5.140.d:
तव तातो मया दृष्टः शक्रस्य सदनं प्रति ..
क्षुत्पिपासापरीतांगो दीनात्मा देवमध्यगः .. 33 ..
5.140.m: 'I saw your father at the abode of Śakra, / his limbs overcome by hunger and thirst, wretched at heart in the midst of the gods.

5.140.s:
tasmātputro'si cenmahyaṃ tvaṃ satyaṃ parirakṣasi ..
tanmannāmnā prayacchoccaiḥ sasyāni salilāni ca .. 34 ..
5.140.d:
तस्मात्पुत्रोऽसि चेन्मह्यं त्वं सत्यं परिरक्षसि ..
तन्मन्नाम्ना प्रयच्छोच्चैः सस्यानि सलिलानि च .. 34 ..
5.140.m: Therefore, if you are my son, [and] you uphold the truth, / then give abundant grain and water in my name.'"

5.140.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya nārado munisattamaḥ ..
anujñāpya sahasrākṣaṃ prasthito bhūtalaṃ prati .. 35 ..
5.140.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
अनुज्ञाप्य सहस्राक्षं प्रस्थितो भूतलं प्रति .. 35 ..
5.140.m: Consenting with "So be it," Nārada, the best of sages, / took leave of the thousand-eyed [Indra] and set out for the surface of the earth.

5.140.s:
tataḥ krameṇa tīrthāni bhramamāṇaḥ sa saddvijaḥ ..
ānarttaviṣayaṃ prāpya satyasenamupādravat .. 36 ..
5.140.d:
ततः क्रमेण तीर्थानि भ्रममाणः स सद्द्विजः ..
आनर्त्तविषयं प्राप्य सत्यसेनमुपाद्रवत् .. 36 ..
5.140.m: Then, wandering in due course through the sacred fords, that virtuous twice-born / reached the region of Ānarta and approached Satyasena.

5.140.s:
atha saṃpūjitastena samyagbhūpatinā muniḥ ..
pituḥ saṃdeśamācakhyau vijane tasya sādaram .. 37 ..
5.140.d:
अथ संपूजितस्तेन सम्यग्भूपतिना मुनिः ..
पितुः संदेशमाचख्यौ विजने तस्य सादरम् .. 37 ..
5.140.m: Then, duly worshipped by that king, the sage / respectfully conveyed his father's message to him in private.

5.140.s:
tacchrutvā śokasaṃtaptaḥ satyaseno mahīpatiḥ ..
taṃ visṛjya muniśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ . 38 ..
5.140.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा शोकसंतप्तः सत्यसेनो महीपतिः ..
तं विसृज्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं पूजयित्वा विधानतः . 38 ..
5.140.m: Hearing that, King Satyasena was afflicted with grief; / having taken leave of that best of sages after worshipping him according to the rules,

5.140.s:
tato janakamuddiśya miṣṭānnena subhaktitaḥ ..
sahasraṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ .. 39 ..
5.140.d:
ततो जनकमुद्दिश्य मिष्टान्नेन सुभक्तितः ..
सहस्रं ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां भोजयामास नित्यशः .. 39 ..
5.140.m: he then daily fed a thousand leading brahmins / with sweet food, out of great devotion for the sake of his father.

5.140.s:
prapādānaṃ tathā cakre grīṣmakāle viśeṣataḥ ..
tyaktvānyāḥ sakalā yāśca kriyā dharmasamudbhavāḥ .. 6.141.40 .
evaṃ tasya mahīpasya vartamānasya ca dvijāḥ ..
anāvṛṣṭirabhūdraudrā sarvasasyakṣayāvahā .. 41 ..
5.140.d:
प्रपादानं तथा चक्रे ग्रीष्मकाले विशेषतः ..
त्यक्त्वान्याः सकला याश्च क्रिया धर्मसमुद्भवाः .. 6.141.40 .
एवं तस्य महीपस्य वर्तमानस्य च द्विजाः ..
अनावृष्टिरभूद्रौद्रा सर्वसस्यक्षयावहा .. 41 ..
5.140.m: He likewise established cisterns for distributing water, especially in the summer season, / setting aside all other religious duties, O twice-born; / and while that king was living in this manner, / there occurred a dreadful drought causing the destruction of all crops.

5.140.s:
yāvaddvādaśavarṣāṇi na jalaṃ tridaśādhipaḥ ..
mumoca dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe sarve lokāḥ kṣudhārditāḥ .. 42 ..
5.140.d:
यावद्द्वादशवर्षाणि न जलं त्रिदशाधिपः ..
मुमोच धरणीपृष्ठे सर्वे लोकाः क्षुधार्दिताः .. 42 ..
5.140.m: For twelve years the lord of the thirty [gods] did not release / water onto the surface of the earth; all creatures were tormented by hunger.

5.140.s:
atrābhāvāttato bhūyo na sasyaṃ saṃprayacchati ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samuddiśya pitaraṃ svaṃ yathā purā .. 43 ..
5.140.d:
अत्राभावात्ततो भूयो न सस्यं संप्रयच्छति ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समुद्दिश्य पितरं स्वं यथा पुरा .. 43 ..
5.140.m: Then, owing to a lack of food, he could no longer give grain / to the brahmins for the sake of his father, as he had before.

5.140.s:
tataḥ sa kṣutparītāṃgaḥ pitā tasya mahīpateḥ ..
svapne provāca taṃ putramatīva malināṃbaraḥ .. 44 ..
5.140.d:
ततः स क्षुत्परीतांगः पिता तस्य महीपतेः ..
स्वप्ने प्रोवाच तं पुत्रमतीव मलिनांबरः .. 44 ..
5.140.m: Then the father of that king, his limbs overcome by hunger / and wearing exceedingly dirty garments, spoke to his son in a dream:

5.140.s:
tvayā putreṇa putrāhaṃ kṣutpipāsāsamākulaḥ ..
svargastho'pi hi tiṣṭhāmi tasmādannaṃ prayaccha vai ..
mannāmnā toyasaṃyuktaṃ yadi tvaṃ matsamudbhavaḥ .. 45 ..
5.140.d:
त्वया पुत्रेण पुत्राहं क्षुत्पिपासासमाकुलः ..
स्वर्गस्थोऽपि हि तिष्ठामि तस्मादन्नं प्रयच्छ वै ..
मन्नाम्ना तोयसंयुक्तं यदि त्वं मत्समुद्भवः .. 45 ..
5.140.m: "Though I have you as my son, my son, / even while residing in heaven I stand distressed with hunger and thirst; therefore give food / along with water in my name, if you are born of me!"

5.140.s:
tataḥ śokasamāyuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ svapnadarśanāt ..
annābhāvātsamaṃ maṃtraṃ maṃtribhiḥ sa tadākarot .. 46 ..
5.140.d:
ततः शोकसमायुक्तः स नृपः स्वप्नदर्शनात् ..
अन्नाभावात्समं मंत्रं मंत्रिभिः स तदाकरोत् .. 46 ..
5.140.m: Then the king, overcome with sorrow from seeing the dream / and because of the lack of food, held counsel with his ministers:

5.140.s:
ahamārādhayiṣyāmi sasyārthe vṛṣabhadhvajam ..
rājye rakṣā vidhātavyā bhavadbhiḥ sādaraṃ sadā .. 47 ..
5.140.d:
अहमाराधयिष्यामि सस्यार्थे वृषभध्वजम् ..
राज्ये रक्षा विधातव्या भवद्भिः सादरं सदा .. 47 ..
5.140.m: "I shall propitiate the one whose banner bears the bull for the sake of grain; / you must carefully maintain the protection of the kingdom at all times."

5.140.s:
tato'traiva samāgatya sthāpayitvā maheśvaram ..
samyagārādhayāmāsa vrataiśca niyamaistathā..48..
5.140.d:
ततोऽत्रैव समागत्य स्थापयित्वा महेश्वरम् ..
सम्यगाराधयामास व्रतैश्च नियमैस्तथा..48..
5.140.m: Then, having come right here and installed the Great Lord, / he propitiated him properly with vows and observances.

5.140.s:
atha tasya gatastuṣṭiṃ varṣāṃte bhagavāñchivaḥ..
abravīdvarado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam..49..
rājovāca..
annārthaṃ devadeveśa mayāyaṃ vihito vidhiḥ..
tasmāttvaṃ yaccha me śīghramasaṃkhyaṃ vṛṣavāhana..6.141.5...
5.140.d:
अथ तस्य गतस्तुष्टिं वर्षांते भगवाञ्छिवः..
अब्रवीद्वरदोऽस्मीति प्रार्थयस्व यथेप्सितम्..49..
राजोवाच..
अन्नार्थं देवदेवेश मयायं विहितो विधिः..
तस्मात्त्वं यच्छ मे शीघ्रमसंख्यं वृषवाहन..6.141.5...
5.140.m:
Then, at the end of a year, the blessed Śiva became pleased with him, / and said, "I am the granter of boons; ask whatever you desire."
The king said: / "For the sake of food this ritual was performed by me, O god of gods! / Therefore quickly grant me food in infinite quantity, O bull-mounted god!

5.140.s:
tathā saṃjāyatā vṛṣṭiḥ samaste dharaṇītale ..
yena sasyāni jāyaṃte salilāni ca sāṃpratam .. 51 ..
5.140.d:
तथा संजायता वृष्टिः समस्ते धरणीतले ..
येन सस्यानि जायंते सलिलानि च सांप्रतम् .. 51 ..
5.140.m: Likewise, let rain fall across the whole surface of the earth, / by which grain and water may now be produced!

5.140.s:
jāyatāṃ mama tātasya svargasthasya mahātmanaḥ ..
prasādāttava saṃtṛptirakṣayā surasattama ..52..
5.140.d:
जायतां मम तातस्य स्वर्गस्थस्य महात्मनः ..
प्रसादात्तव संतृप्तिरक्षया सुरसत्तम ..52..
5.140.m: Let there be inexhaustible satisfaction, by your grace, / for my noble father dwelling in heaven, O best of gods!"

5.140.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
bhavitā na cirādvṛṣṭiḥ prabhūtā dharaṇītale ..
bhaviṣyaṃti tathānnāni yāni kāni mahītale .. 53 ..
5.140.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
भविता न चिराद्वृष्टिः प्रभूता धरणीतले ..
भविष्यंति तथान्नानि यानि कानि महीतले .. 53 ..
5.140.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "Before long there will be abundant rain on the surface of the earth, / and all kinds of food will come to be on the earth.

5.140.s:
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha rājeṃdra svagṛhaṃ prati sāṃpratam..
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhametadeva bhaviṣyati ..54 ..
5.140.d:
तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ राजेंद्र स्वगृहं प्रति सांप्रतम्..
मम वाक्यादसंदिग्धमेतदेव भविष्यति ..54 ..
5.140.m: Therefore go to your own home right now, O king of kings; / by my word, this shall happen without a doubt.

5.140.s:
taccaitanmāmakaṃ liṃgaṃ yattvayā sthāpitaṃ nṛpa ..
prātarutthāya yaḥ kaścitsamyaktadvīkṣayiṣyati .. 55 ..
5.140.d:
तच्चैतन्मामकं लिंगं यत्त्वया स्थापितं नृप ..
प्रातरुत्थाय यः कश्चित्सम्यक्तद्वीक्षयिष्यति .. 55 ..
5.140.m: And whoever, rising in the morning, properly gazes / upon this liṅga of mine that was installed by you, O king,

5.140.s:
miṣṭānnamamṛtasvādu sa hi nūnamavāpsyati..
mama vākyānnṛpaśreṣṭha sadā janmanijanmani .. 56 ..
5.140.d:
मिष्टान्नममृतस्वादु स हि नूनमवाप्स्यति..
मम वाक्यान्नृपश्रेष्ठ सदा जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 56 ..
5.140.m: will surely obtain sweet food as delicious as nectar / in birth after birth always, by my word, O best of kings."

5.140.s:
sa evaṃ bhagavānuktvā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
so'pi rājā nijaṃ sthānaṃ harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ ..
ājagāma cakārātha rājyaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam ..57..
5.140.d:
स एवं भगवानुक्त्वा ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
सोऽपि राजा निजं स्थानं हर्षेण महतान्वितः ..
आजगाम चकाराथ राज्यं निहतकंटकम् ..57..
5.140.m: Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord then disappeared; / that king also returned to his own place filled with great joy, / and ruled his kingdom free of thorns.

5.140.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
adyāpi kalikāle'tra saṃprāpte dāruṇe yuge ..
yastaṃ miṣṭānnadaṃ paśyetprātarutthāya bhaktitaḥ ..58..
5.140.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अद्यापि कलिकालेऽत्र संप्राप्ते दारुणे युगे ..
यस्तं मिष्टान्नदं पश्येत्प्रातरुत्थाय भक्तितः ..58..
5.140.m: Sūta said: / Even today in this Kali age, when this terrible epoch has arrived, / whoever rising in the morning gazes with devotion upon that [liṅga] which gives sweet food,

5.140.s:
sa miṣṭānnamavāpnoti yadi kāmayate dvijāḥ ..
niṣkāmo vā samabhyeti sthānaṃ devasya śūlinaḥ.. 59 ..
5.140.d:
स मिष्टान्नमवाप्नोति यदि कामयते द्विजाः ..
निष्कामो वा समभ्येति स्थानं देवस्य शूलिनः.. 59 ..
5.140.m: attains sweet food if he desires it, O twice-born; / or, if he is desireless, he reaches the abode of the trident-bearing god.

5.140.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye miṣṭānnadeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..141..
5.140.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मिष्टान्नदेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..141..
5.140.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Miṣṭānnadeśvara' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.141.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi tatrāsti puṇyaṃ gaṇapatitrayam ..
svargadaṃ martyadaṃ puṇyaṃ tathānyannarakāpaham..1..
5.141.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति पुण्यं गणपतित्रयम् ..
स्वर्गदं मर्त्यदं पुण्यं तथान्यन्नरकापहम्..1..
5.141.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is also another sacred triad of Gaṇapatis there, / holy, granting heaven, granting the mortal realm, and also averting hell,

5.141.s:
haṃtṛ vai sarvavighnānāṃ pūjitaṃ suradānavaiḥ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ caiva vidyākīrtivivardhanam .. 2 ..
5.141.d:
हंतृ वै सर्वविघ्नानां पूजितं सुरदानवैः..
सर्वकामप्रदं चैव विद्याकीर्तिविवर्धनम् .. 2 ..
5.141.m: destroying all obstacles, worshipped by gods and Dānavas, / bestowing all desires, and increasing learning and fame.

5.141.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
trividhāḥ puruṣāḥ sūta jāyaṃtetra mahītale ..
uttamā madhyamāścānye tathā cānye'dhamāḥ sthitāḥ .. 3 ..
5.141.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
त्रिविधाः पुरुषाः सूत जायंतेत्र महीतले ..
उत्तमा मध्यमाश्चान्ये तथा चान्येऽधमाः स्थिताः .. 3 ..
5.141.m: The seers said: / Three kinds of men are born here on the surface of the earth, O Sūta: / the highest, the middling, and others who are base.

5.141.s:
uttamāḥ prārthayaṃti sma mokṣameva hi kevalam ..
gatā yatra nivartaṃte na kathaṃciddharātale .. 4 ..
5.141.d:
उत्तमाः प्रार्थयंति स्म मोक्षमेव हि केवलम् ..
गता यत्र निवर्तंते न कथंचिद्धरातले .. 4 ..
5.141.m: The highest pray for liberation alone, / having gone to which they never return in any way to the surface of the earth.

5.141.s:
madhyamāḥ svargamārgaṃ ca divyānbhogānmanoramān ..
apsarobhiḥ samaṃ krīḍāṃ yajñādyaiḥ karmabhiḥ kṛtām .. .. 5 ..
5.141.d:
मध्यमाः स्वर्गमार्गं च दिव्यान्भोगान्मनोरमान् ..
अप्सरोभिः समं क्रीडां यज्ञाद्यैः कर्मभिः कृताम् .. .. 5 ..
5.141.m: The middling [pray for] the path to heaven and delightful celestial enjoyments, / sport with apsarases, attained by rites such as sacrifices.

5.141.s:
adhamā martyaloketra ramaṃte viṣayātmakāḥ ..
viṣakīṭakavattatra ratiṃ kṛtvā garīyasīm .. 6 .
5.141.d:
अधमा मर्त्यलोकेत्र रमंते विषयात्मकाः ..
विषकीटकवत्तत्र रतिं कृत्वा गरीयसीम् .. 6 .
5.141.m: The base, devoted to sensory objects, delight here in the mortal world, / taking great pleasure there like worms in poison.

5.141.s:
svargamokṣau parityajya tatkasmānmartya iṣyate ..
yenāsau prārthyate martyairmartyado gaṇanāyakaḥ .. 7 ..
5.141.d:
स्वर्गमोक्षौ परित्यज्य तत्कस्मान्मर्त्य इष्यते ..
येनासौ प्रार्थ्यते मर्त्यैर्मर्त्यदो गणनायकः .. 7 ..
5.141.m: Why, having abandoned heaven and liberation, is mortal existence desired, / on account of which that lord of gaṇas, the granter of mortal existence, is besought by mortals?

5.141.s:
kena saṃsthāpitāste ca tasminkṣetre gajānanāḥ ..
kasminkāle ca draṣṭavyāḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 8 ..
5.141.d:
केन संस्थापितास्ते च तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे गजाननाः ..
कस्मिन्काले च द्रष्टव्याः सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 8 ..
5.141.m: And by whom were those elephant-faced ones installed in that sacred field? / At what time should they be seen? Tell everything in detail.

5.141.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pūrvaṃ taptvā tapastīvraṃ martyaloke dvijottamāḥ ..
tato gacchaṃti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ svecchayā tridivaṃ prati ..
mokṣamārgaṃ tathaivānye dhyānāviṣkṛtamānasāḥ .. 9 ..
5.141.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पूर्वं तप्त्वा तपस्तीव्रं मर्त्यलोके द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ततो गच्छंति संहृष्टाः स्वेच्छया त्रिदिवं प्रति ..
मोक्षमार्गं तथैवान्ये ध्यानाविष्कृतमानसाः .. 9 ..
5.141.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, having performed severe austerity in the mortal world, best of brahmins, / then, overjoyed, they would go to heaven according to their own wish; / others likewise [went on] the path to liberation, their minds enlightened by meditation.

5.141.s:
tataḥ svarge samākīrṇe kadācinmanujottamaiḥ ..
deveṣu kṣipyamāṇeṣu samaṃtāttatprabhāvataḥ .. 6.142.10 ..
5.141.d:
ततः स्वर्गे समाकीर्णे कदाचिन्मनुजोत्तमैः ..
देवेषु क्षिप्यमाणेषु समंतात्तत्प्रभावतः .. 6.142.10 ..
5.141.m: Then, once heaven had become crowded with the best of men, / and the gods were being displaced all around due to their power,

5.141.s:
gatvā svayaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha ..
provāca śaṃkaraṃ gauryā sārdhamekāsanasthitam .. 11 ..
5.141.d:
गत्वा स्वयं सहस्राक्षः सर्वैर्देवगणैः सह ..
प्रोवाच शंकरं गौर्या सार्धमेकासनस्थितम् .. 11 ..
5.141.m: the thousand-eyed one [Indra] himself, having gone along with all the hosts of gods, / spoke to Śaṃkara, who was seated upon one throne together with Gaurī.

5.141.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
tapaḥprabhāvasaṃsiddhairmānavaiḥ parameśvara ..
asmākaṃ vyāpyate sarvaṃ mahimānaṃ gṛhādikam.. 12 ..
5.141.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
तपःप्रभावसंसिद्धैर्मानवैः परमेश्वर ..
अस्माकं व्याप्यते सर्वं महिमानं गृहादिकम्.. 12 ..
5.141.m: Indra said: / O Supreme Lord, by mortals perfected through the power of austerity / our entire glory, dwellings, and so forth are being occupied.

5.141.s:
tasmātkṛtvā prasādaṃ naḥ kaṃcicciṃtaya sāṃpratam ..
upāyaṃ yena tiṣṭhāmaḥ saukhyenātra śivālaye .. 13 ..
5.141.d:
तस्मात्कृत्वा प्रसादं नः कंचिच्चिंतय सांप्रतम् ..
उपायं येन तिष्ठामः सौख्येनात्र शिवालये .. 13 ..
5.141.m: Therefore, having shown us favor, devise some means now / whereby we may abide happily here in the abode of Śiva.

5.141.s:
atha śrutvā virūpākṣasteṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ dvijāḥ ..
pārvatyāḥ pārśvasaṃsthāyā mukhacandraṃ samaikṣayat .. 14 ..
5.141.d:
अथ श्रुत्वा विरूपाक्षस्तेषां तद्वचनं द्विजाः ..
पार्वत्याः पार्श्वसंस्थाया मुखचन्द्रं समैक्षयत् .. 14 ..
5.141.m: Then, having heard that speech of theirs, O brahmins, the three-eyed one [Virūpākṣa] / looked at the moon-like face of Pārvatī standing beside him.

5.141.s:
nijagātraṃ tato devī susaṃmardya muhurmuhuḥ ..
malamāhṛtya taṃ kṛtsnaṃ cakre nāgamukhaṃ tataḥ 15..
5.141.d:
निजगात्रं ततो देवी सुसंमर्द्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
मलमाहृत्य तं कृत्स्नं चक्रे नागमुखं ततः 15..
